mon_broken_cyborg.name: broken cyborg
mon_broken_cyborg.description: A robot body with the head of a human.  All kinds of electronic wires and devices are implanted in its head.  Patches of skin look diseased or rotting.  This cyborg moves erratically and has a confused and deranged look in its eyes.

mon_prototype_cyborg.name: prototype cyborg
mon_prototype_cyborg.description: A human fused with a mess of metal parts and wires.  While its eyes are empty, flashes of pain pass across its face reminiscent of the person trapped in this grotesque body.  With enough surgical skills one might be able to give them back some humanity.  If only they cared…

mon_copbot.name: police bot
mon_copbot.description: One of the many models of armored law enforcement robots employed shortly before the collapse of civilization.  Solar powered like many other robots, it maintains its programmed pursuit of law and order, propelled on a trio of omni wheels.

mon_riotbot.name: riot control bot
mon_riotbot.description: Nonviolent riot-control bot.  Designed to suppress riots and make mass arrests of those participating.  Though its relaxation gas is by far its best-known weapon, it carries a blinding flash and a low-powered stungun for self-defense--in addition to its supply of electronic handcuffs.

mon_secubot.name: M16A4 autonomous TALON UGV
mon_secubot.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

mon_talon_m202a1.name: M202A1 autonomous TALON UGV
mon_talon_m202a1.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M202A1 FLASH.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

mon_talon_m249.name: M249 autonomous TALON UGV
mon_talon_m249.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M249.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount, designed to provide high volume, if inaccurate, fire.

mon_skitterbot.name: skitterbot
mon_skitterbot.description: An insectoid robot the size of a small dog, designed for home security.  Armed with two close-range tazers, it can skate across the ground with great speed.

mon_science_bot.name: experimental lab bot
mon_science_bot.description: This robot looks like a large metal spider, a bit bigger than a person, with its thorax covered in tiny holes.  An ominous buzzing emanates from it.

mon_robofac_prototype.name: prototype robot
mon_robofac_prototype.description: The single glowing eye of this robot surveys the landscape periodically, as it performs the endless slaughter dictated by a misinterpreted and cruel routine.  Between half-built plates, you can see the machinery and cables that animate it, and yet it moves deftly as it switches between one target and the next.

mon_dispatch.name: NR-031 Dispatch
mon_dispatch.description: The Northrop Dispatch, designed for crowd control situations, carries and deploys kamikaze drones of various types.  The bright green-and-yellow paint marks a low-force variant - *comparatively* low-force, anyways - typically deployed as guards after an area has been cleared.

mon_dispatch_military.name: NR-V05-M Dispatch
mon_dispatch_military.description: The Northrop Dispatch, designed for crowd control situations, carries and deploys kamikaze drones of various types.  The dark green paint job marks the lethal and feared military variant, carrying extreme and deadly firepower.

mon_tankbot.name: Beagle Mini-Tank UGV
mon_tankbot.description: The Northrop Beagle is a refrigerator-sized urban warfare UGV.  Sporting an anti-tank missile launcher, 40mm grenade launcher, and numerous anti-infantry weapons, it's designed for high-risk urban fighting.

mon_tripod.name: tripod
mon_tripod.description: The Honda Regnal, a tall robot walking on three spidery legs.  For weapons, it has a trio of spiked retractable cables and a flamethrower mounted on its head.

mon_chickenbot.name: chicken walker
mon_chickenbot.description: The Northrop ATSV, a massive, heavily-armed and armored robot walking on a pair of reverse-jointed legs.  Armed with a 40mm anti-vehicle grenade launcher, 5.56 anti-personnel gun, and the ability to electrify itself against attackers, it is an effective automated sentry, though production was limited due to a legal dispute.

mon_uafv_xm246e1.name: XM246E1 Mini-Tank UAFV
mon_uafv_xm246e1.description: An experimental, heavily armored UGV the size of a small vehicle, its structure dominated by a bulky 120mm main gun.  It trundles along on armored treads, ponderous yet implacable.  If it's taking aim at you… run.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "120mm HEAT, up.  Targeting.  On the way."
special_attacks.description: The mini-tank fires its 120mm gun!

mon_EMP_hack.name: EMP hack
mon_EMP_hack.description: An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have an EMP grenade inside.

mon_c4_hack.name: C-4 hack
mon_c4_hack.description: An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have some C-4 inside.

mon_flashbang_hack.name: flashbang hack
mon_flashbang_hack.description: An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have a flashbang inside.

mon_gasbomb_hack.name: tear gas hack
mon_gasbomb_hack.description: An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have a tear gas canister inside.

mon_grenade_hack.name: grenade hack
mon_grenade_hack.description: An automated kamikaze drone, this small quadcopter robot appears to have a grenade inside.

mon_manhack.name: manhack
mon_manhack.description: An automated anti-personnel drone, a small quadcopter robot surrounded by whirring blades.

mon_mininuke_hack.name: mininuke hack
mon_mininuke_hack.description: Many times as large as a normal manhack, this flying quadcopter drone appears to have a mininuke inside.  If this is targeting you…  Run.

mon_feral_human_pipe.name: feral human
mon_feral_human_pipe.description: Their pupils are dilated and what remains to be seen of the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  This pipe-wielding maniac still breathes, but the zombies treat them like one of their own.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_human_crowbar.name: feral human
mon_feral_human_crowbar.description: Their pupils are dilated and what remains to be seen of the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  This crowbar-wielding maniac still breathes, but the zombies treat them like one of their own.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_human_axe.name: feral axeman
mon_feral_human_axe.description: They stumble along dragging a large bloodstained axe.  Their face is twisted into a sadistic grin, and they walk among the dead as though already one of them.

mon_feral_human_chainsaw.name: feral chainsaw maniac
mon_feral_human_chainsaw.description: This crazed shambler seems to still be alive, and yet the dead treat them like one of their own.  Please tell me that's not a chainsaw he's carrying…

mon_feral_scientist_scalpel.name: feral scientist
mon_feral_scientist_scalpel.description: A researcher who has stared too long into the abyss, and now shambles about muttering nonsense under their breath.  For some reason, the zombies don't seem to mind that this person is obviously still alive.  They're clutching a tiny but razor-sharp blade in one shaky hand.

mon_feral_labsecurity_9mm.name: feral security guard
mon_feral_labsecurity_9mm.description: This security guard still breathes, but has been lost to some terrible madness.  They move among the undead, handgun at the ready and dilated pupils scanning for threats in a mockery of their former duty.

special_attacks.description: The feral security guard fires their pistol!

mon_feral_labsecurity_flashlight.name: feral security guard
mon_feral_labsecurity_flashlight.description: At first glance, this disheveled figure could almost pass for a survivor, but the bloodshot eyes give them away as one of those to have gone feral.  Their uniform suggests that this was at some point a security guard, brandishing a stun gun in one hand while a clutching a flashlight in the other.

mon_feral_human_tool.name: feral mechanic
mon_feral_human_tool.description: This wild human-like creature was probably a mechanic before the cataclysm.  You can see it by his worker uniform, or by the blood-covered hammer in his hand.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_jackboot.name: feral biker
mon_feral_jackboot.description: A rough-looking feral human, clad in black leather and wielding a pump-action shotgun.  It seems body-armor wasn't one of their priorities however.

special_attacks.description: The feral biker fires their shotgun!

mon_feral_maid_broom.name: feral servant
mon_feral_maid_broom.description: Once a fancy servant of some rich family, this maniac walks around with broom in hand, searching for a victim to clean from its life.

mon_feral_maid_candlestick.name: feral servant
mon_feral_maid_candlestick.description: Once a fancy servant of some rich family, this maniac walks around with candlestick in hand, eager to turn off your lights.

mon_feral_maid_knife.name: feral servant
mon_feral_maid_knife.description: Once a fancy servant of some rich family, this maniac walks around with knife in hand, seeking victims to butcher for the next meal.

mon_feral_fancy_rapier.name: well dressed feral
mon_feral_fancy_rapier.description: Wearing fancy clothes and with rapier in hand, this maniac was once a socialite.  It smiles with madness and seems like it wants to invite you to dinner.

mon_feral_fancy_rapier_fake.name: well dressed feral
mon_feral_fancy_rapier_fake.description: Wearing fancy clothes and with rapier in hand, this maniac was once a socialite.  It smiles with madness and seems like it wants to invite you to dinner.

mon_feral_fancy_crossbow.name: well dressed feral
mon_feral_fancy_crossbow.description: Wearing fancy clothes and with crossbow in hand, this maniac was once a socialite.  Its hands seem to caress the crossbow as if touching a loved one.

special_attacks.description: The feral human shoots its crossbow!

mon_feral_armored_mace.name: armored feral
mon_feral_armored_mace.description: Clad in ancient armor with mace in hand, this maniac walks around in search of prey.  You can see stains of dried blood all around its mace.

mon_feral_armored_battleaxe.name: armored feral
mon_feral_armored_battleaxe.description: Clad in ancient armor with battle axe in hand, this maniac walks around in search of prey.  You can see stains of dried blood all around its axe.

mon_feral_prepper.name: feral prepper
mon_feral_prepper.description: A quick glance would show that this person was prepared for times like these.  Unfortunately, their bloodshot eyes, and lack of attention from the undead shows that they have turned feral.  One of their hands clasps the handle of a makeshift club, while the other grips a pistol.

special_attacks.description: The feral prepper haphazardly fires their firearm!

mon_feral_survivalist.name: feral survivalist
mon_feral_survivalist.description: Grasping a razor-sharp weapon, this feral prepper has an athletic body, a sign of intense training before they turned feral.  In addition to holding a flashlight, they seem to have a greater sense of self-preservation for a feral, a hint of leftover survival instincts kicking in.

mon_feral_militia.name: feral militia
mon_feral_militia.description: Wearing a camo uniform with a kevlar vest, this person was a militia member turned feral.  Their hands grip an automatic rifle as bloodshot eyes scan around; a headlamp above them illuminating their surroundings.

special_attacks.description: The feral militia fires their machine gun!

mon_feral_soldier.name: feral soldier
mon_feral_soldier.description: Wearing a military uniform with a ballistic vest, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Tense, dirty hands grip a combat knife as their bloodshot eyes scan for threats.

mon_feral_pa_boss.name: feral armored bio-operator
mon_feral_pa_boss.description: Wearing an advanced suit of power armor, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Worse, the faint electrical crackling that emanates from their body indicates heavy bionic augmentation.

special_attacks.monster_message: The feral activates its time dilation bionic, and suddenly moves with a burst of speed!

mon_feral_pa_boss_melee.name: feral armored bio-operator
mon_feral_pa_boss_melee.description: Wearing an advanced suit of power armor, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Worse, the faint electrical crackling that emanates from their body indicates heavy bionic augmentation.  Bionic claws extend from its hands, and it seems to maintain a martial arts stance.

special_attacks.monster_message: The feral activates its time dilation bionic, and suddenly moves with a burst of speed!

mon_feral_pa_boss_shotgun.name: feral armored bio-operator
mon_feral_pa_boss_shotgun.description: Wearing an advanced suit of power armor, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Worse, the faint electrical crackling that emanates from their body indicates heavy bionic augmentation.  A bionic shotgun extends from its arm.

special_attacks.monster_message: The feral activates its time dilation bionic, and suddenly moves with a burst of speed!

special_attacks.description: The feral armored bio-operator fires its bionic shotgun!

mon_feral_pa_boss_grenade.name: feral armored bio-operator
mon_feral_pa_boss_grenade.description: Wearing an advanced suit of power armor, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Worse, the faint electrical crackling that emanates from their body indicates heavy bionic augmentation.  A bionic grenade launcher extends from its arm.

special_attacks.monster_message: The feral activates its time dilation bionic, and suddenly moves with a burst of speed!

special_attacks.description: The feral armored bio-operator fires its bionic grenade launcher!

mon_feral_pa_boss_blaster.name: feral armored bio-operator
mon_feral_pa_boss_blaster.description: Wearing an advanced suit of power armor, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Worse, the faint electrical crackling that emanates from their body indicates heavy bionic augmentation.  A bionic fusion blaster extends from its arm.

special_attacks.monster_message: The feral activates its time dilation bionic, and suddenly moves with a burst of speed!

special_attacks.description: The feral armored bio-operator fires its bionic fusion blaster!

mon_feral_corpo.name: feral corporate executive
mon_feral_corpo.description: Still dressed in press interview attire, this tall, well-built corpo appears to have cracked under crushing paranoia. With an automatic rifle in hand, they keep mumbling to themselves about something finance-related, unable to stand still for even a moment as a tightly wound bundle of nerves. While they don't look trained in rifle usage, it would be unwise to approach without a plan.

special_attacks.description: The feral corporate executive fires their auto rifle!

mon_feral_bodyguard.name: feral bodyguard
mon_feral_bodyguard.description: This overly tense bodyguard doesn't look any different from a normal one - except for his bloodshot eyes, unnervingly grating teeth, and sheen of sweat. While much calmer than his VIP, he is no less deadly.

special_attacks.description: The feral bodyguard fires their pistol!

mon_feral_blackops_boss_commander.name: feral black-ops
mon_feral_blackops_boss_commander.description: Dressed in a suit of unmarked black armor and surrounded by a shadowy field, this heavily armed feral looks to be part of an elite unit. Now that you've stumbled upon their operation, you're just another loose thread to clean up...

special_attacks.description: The feral black-ops fires their SPIW!

mon_feral_blackops_boss_bioop.name: feral black-ops
mon_feral_blackops_boss_bioop.description: Dressed in a suit of unmarked black armor and surrounded by a shadowy field, this heavily armed feral looks to be part of an elite unit. Now that you've stumbled upon their operation, you're just another loose thread to clean up...

mon_feral_blackops_boss_technician.name: feral black-ops
mon_feral_blackops_boss_technician.description: Dressed in a suit of unmarked black armor and surrounded by a shadowy field, this heavily armed feral looks to be part of an elite unit. Now that you've stumbled upon their operation, you're just another loose thread to clean up...

special_attacks.description: The feral black-ops fires their automagnum!

mon_feral_blackops_boss_sniper.name: feral black-ops
mon_feral_blackops_boss_sniper.description: Dressed in a suit of unmarked black armor and surrounded by a shadowy field, this heavily armed feral looks to be part of an elite unit. Now that you've stumbled upon their operation, you're just another loose thread to clean up...

special_attacks.description: The feral black-ops fires their sniper rifle!

mon_feral_swat_boss_commander.name: feral SWAT officer
mon_feral_swat_boss_commander.description: Wearing a black uniform with heavy armor adorned with a silver badge, this person was a member of an elite police team turned feral.  Their hands grip a rifle.

special_attacks.description: The feral SWAT officer fires their rifle!

mon_feral_swat_boss_shieldman.name: feral SWAT shieldbearer
mon_feral_swat_boss_shieldman.description: Wearing a black uniform with heavy armor adorned with a silver badge, this person was a member of an elite police team turned feral.  They hold a heavy ballistic shield in one hand and a pistol in the other.  It looks like you won't be able to smack this shield away like the others though.

special_attacks.description: The feral SWAT shieldman fires their pistol!

mon_feral_swat_boss_grenadier.name: feral SWAT grenadier
mon_feral_swat_boss_grenadier.description: Wearing a black uniform with heavy armor adorned with a silver badge and a belt of tear gas grenades, this person was a member of an elite police team turned feral.  They hold a tear gas grenade at the ready.

special_attacks.description: The feral SWAT grenadier throws a tear gas grenade!

mon_feral_swat_boss_cloaker.name: feral SWAT cloaker
mon_feral_swat_boss_cloaker.description: Wearing a black uniform with heavy armor adorned with a silver badge, this person was a member of an elite police team turned feral.  Darkness shrouds their fast approach, and a shrill, electronic wailing emanates from the figure.

mon_alpha_razorclaw.name: alpha razorclaw
mon_alpha_razorclaw.description: A blood red, gigantic razorclaw.  Its sword like pincers serve as the keepers of the nest.

mon_fish_trout.description: A trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
mon_fish_trout.name: trout

mon_fish_brown_trout.description: A brown trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
mon_fish_brown_trout.name: brown trout

mon_fish_brook_trout.description: A brook trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.

mon_fish_lake_trout.name: lake trout

mon_fish_steelhead_trout.description: A steelhead trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.
mon_fish_steelhead_trout.name: steelhead trout

mon_fish_salmon.description: An Atlantic salmon.  A very fatty, nutritious fish.  Tastes great smoked.
mon_fish_salmon.name: salmon

mon_fish_kokanee_salmon.description: A Kokanee salmon.  A very fatty, nutritious fish.  Tastes great smoked.
mon_fish_kokanee_salmon.name: kokanee salmon

mon_fish_chinook_salmon.description: A Chinook salmon.  A very fatty, nutritious fish.  Tastes great smoked.

mon_fish_coho_salmon.description: A Coho salmon.  A very fatty, nutritious fish.  Tastes great smoked.
mon_fish_coho_salmon.name: coho salmon

mon_fish_whitefish.description: A whitefish, closely related to salmon.  One can assume they are just as nice when cooked with smoke.
mon_fish_whitefish.name: whitefish

mon_fish_lbass.description: A largemouth bass.  Very popular with sports fishermen.
mon_fish_lbass.name: largemouth bass

mon_fish_sbass.name: smallmouth bass
mon_fish_sbass.description: A smallmouth bass.  Being intolerant to pollution in the water, smallmouth bass are a good indicator of how clean it is.

mon_fish_pbass.description: A striped bass.  Mostly a salt water fish, they migrate to fresher water to spawn.
mon_fish_pbass.name: striped bass

mon_fish_white_bass.name: white bass
mon_fish_white_bass.description: A white bass.  Common to the region, a slab-sided and spiny-rayed little fish.

mon_fish_perch.name: perch
mon_fish_perch.description: A small sprightly perch.  A very bony fish, still got some tasty meat on it though.

mon_fish_walleye.description: A walleye, a green-brown medium-sized fish with a white belly.
mon_fish_walleye.name: walleye

mon_fish_sunfish.name: sunfish
mon_fish_sunfish.description: A sunfish.  A small fish related to bass or bluegill.

mon_fish_pumpkinseed.name: pumpkinseed sunfish
mon_fish_pumpkinseed.description: A pumpkinseed sunfish.  A small fish related to bass or bluegill.

mon_fish_bluegill.name: bluegill
mon_fish_bluegill.description: A bluegill, an invasive species in Japan.  Commonly gutted and cooked whole.

mon_fish_redbreast.name: redbreast sunfish
mon_fish_redbreast.description: A redbreast sunfish.  A small fish related to bass or bluegill.

mon_fish_green_sunfish.name: green sunfish
mon_fish_green_sunfish.description: A green sunfish.  A small fish related to bass or bluegill.

mon_fish_longear_sunfish.name: longear sunfish
mon_fish_longear_sunfish.description: A longear sunfish.  A small fish related to bass or bluegill.

mon_fish_redear_sunfish.name: redear sunfish
mon_fish_redear_sunfish.description: A redear sunfish.  A small fish related to bass or bluegill.

mon_fish_rock_bass.name: rock bass
mon_fish_rock_bass.description: A rock bass.  Related to sunfish, this tiny fish has a camouflage-like patterning and a red eye.

mon_fish_calico_bass.description: A calico bass.  A medium-sized fish also known as a 'Crappie'.
mon_fish_calico_bass.name: calico bass

mon_fish_warmouth.name: warmouth
mon_fish_warmouth.description: A warmouth, similar to a rock bass, this small fish is related to the sunfish.

mon_fish_bullhead.name: bullhead
mon_fish_bullhead.description: A bullhead, a type of catfish.  Delicious battered and fried.

mon_fish_channel_catfish.description: A channel catfish, they have a forked tail and long whiskers.
mon_fish_channel_catfish.name: channel catfish

mon_fish_white_catfish.name: white catfish
mon_fish_white_catfish.description: A white catfish, a small whiskered fish with a broad head.

mon_fish_pike.description: A northern pike.  Pike can be a pretty aggressive fish, careful around those teeth.
mon_fish_pike.name: pike

mon_fish_pickerel.name: pickerel
mon_fish_pickerel.description: A pickerel.  It looks like a pike, but much smaller.

mon_fish_muskellunge.description: A muskellunge.  Closely related to pike, it shares the same aggression and sharp teeth.
mon_fish_muskellunge.name: muskellunge

mon_fish_white_sucker.name: white sucker
mon_fish_white_sucker.description: A white sucker.  It has a streamlined body with a round mouth.

mon_fish_carp.description: A golden-yellow common carp.  Some people think they don't taste great, but you can't afford to be choosy in the Cataclysm.
mon_fish_carp.name: carp

mon_fish_grass_carp.description: A huge grass carp.  A golden, herbivorous fish.
mon_fish_grass_carp.name: grass carp

mon_fish_bowfin.description: A bowfin.  These fish are related to gar but without the huge teeth, skin rending scales, and aggression.
mon_fish_bowfin.name: bowfin

mon_fish_fallfish.name: fallfish
mon_fish_fallfish.description: A fallfish.  These fish are related to gar but without the huge teeth, skin rending scales, and aggression.

mon_fish_lobster.name: lobster
mon_fish_lobster.description: These things were once considered pests not worth eating, then some marketing genius started selling them to people as a delicacy and they took off in popularity… and price.

mon_fish_crayfish.name: crayfish
mon_fish_crayfish.description: If you could get a hold of a bunch more of these, a hefty pot of boiling water, and some spicy seasonings…

mon_fish_eel.name: freshwater eel
mon_fish_eel.description: An American eel.  Used to be quite common in these parts until the dams were built.  Guess they'll get a second chance now that they aren't running.

mon_giant_crayfish.name: giant crayfish
mon_giant_crayfish.description: A mutant, terrestrial variety of the signal crayfish, this massive crustacean resembles a humongous lobster.

mon_razorclaw.name: razorclaw
mon_razorclaw.description: A man-sized crustacean clad in an iron-like chitin, capable of emitting the most horrible of shrieks.  Often spotted near shipwrecks or other dark damp places, which it uses as nesting grounds.

mon_mutant_carp.name: giant carp
mon_mutant_carp.description: This thing seems like a carp, only swollen and very very angry.  Death is the gift of the carp god.

mon_mutant_salmon.name: giant salmon
mon_mutant_salmon.description: A mutated salmon, the same size as a large dog and quite dangerous to the inexperienced angler.

mon_sewer_fish.name: seweranha
mon_sewer_fish.description: A large mutant variety of carp, congregating wherever pollution can be found.  It has shimmering green scales and a mouth lined with three jagged rows of razor-sharp teeth.

mon_kraken_boss.name: kraken
mon_kraken_boss.description: A creature of terror from old sailor legend, said to be able to bring down entire ships and swallow a crew whole.  You were sure it was just a legend, but now, seeing this beast's massive, razored tentacles rise from the water, you aren't so sure.  This seems to be the massive creature's main body.

special_attacks.monster_message: The kraken's tentacles rise out of the water!

mon_kraken_boss_tentacle.name: kraken tentacle
mon_kraken_boss_tentacle.description: A massive, razored tentacle rising from the water.  Judging by the tentacle's quickly regenerating flesh, you likely need to attack the creature's main body to inflict lethal damage.

mon_boomer_fungus.name: fungal boomer
mon_boomer_fungus.description: A rotund and bloated human body with pasty, fungus-ridden flesh.  Its mouth drips with a frothing gray sludge.

mon_fungal_blossom.name: fungal blossom
mon_fungal_blossom.description: A broad fungus, looking much like a glowing blue sunflower.  It appears to emit finer spores than the typical fungal emission.

mon_fungal_hedgerow.name: fungal hedgerow
mon_fungal_hedgerow.description: Looking at first glance like a dull gray privet, this "hedge" is really a mass of barbed fungal tendrils, defending the fungal tower.

mon_fungal_tendril.name: fungal tendril
mon_fungal_tendril.description: A long and delicate-looking tendril with a sharp tip.

mon_fungal_wall.name: fungal wall
mon_fungal_wall.description: A veritable wall of fungus, grown as a natural defense by the fungal spire.  New spores erupt from the surface every few seconds, and tendrils constrict around it, pulling new mass into its shape.  They move with an inexorable strength that could snap limbs.

mon_fungaloid.name: fungaloid
mon_fungaloid.description: A pale white fungus, one meaty gray stalk supporting a bloom at the top.  Spores are periodically expelled from its gills, and a few tendrils extend from the base, allowing mobility and some basic means of defense.

mon_fungaloid_queen.name: fungal spire
mon_fungaloid_queen.description: An enormous fungal spire, towering over the ground.  It pulsates slowly, continuously growing new defenses.

mon_fungaloid_seeder.name: giant fungal blossom
mon_fungaloid_seeder.description: An immense fungal blossom, towering over its surroundings.  It pulses with a soft blue glow, continuously pumping its spores into the air.

mon_fungaloid_tower.name: fungal tower
mon_fungaloid_tower.description: An enormous fungal tower.  On closer inspection, its cap is supported by LOTS of fungal tendrils of various thicknesses, emerging from yet more bristling tendrils at ground level.  Between this redundancy and their noticeable movement creating frequent gaps, it's tough to get a solid shot on the thing.

mon_fungaloid_young.name: fungal sporeling
mon_fungaloid_young.description: A fungal stalk several feet in height.  Two vicious looking tendrils extend from its thorned and leathery exterior, and it moves about faster than the larger fungaloids.

mon_spore.name: spore cloud
mon_spore.description: A mass of spores the size of a balled fist, wafting around in the air.

mon_zombie_fungus.name: fungal zombie
mon_zombie_fungus.description: Once human, fungal tendrils now sprout from its mouth, eyes, and other orifices, holding together a shambling mass of mold-covered flesh.

mon_zombie_gasbag_fungus.name: bloated fungal zombie
mon_zombie_gasbag_fungus.description: With its swollen gray skin overgrown by thick layer of mold, this balloon-like fungal zombie looks like it could violently burst with a cloud of noxious spores.

mon_zombie_smoker_fungus.name: pollinator zombie
mon_zombie_smoker_fungus.description: Every breath of this crooked, fungus-ridden zombie emits a fine dust of spores, and it constantly looks like it's emerging from a cloud of mist.

mon_skeleton_hulk_fungus.name: fungal juggernaut
mon_skeleton_hulk_fungus.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the ossified plates of this ponderous bone titan, and it seems even its eyes are lost to it.  A dust of spores lands on the ground with every sluggish stomp of its heavy legs.

mon_zombie_child_fungus.name: fungal child
mon_zombie_child_fungus.description: It is hard to recognize a human child in this creature.  Disgusting-looking mold covers most of its skin.  Many cracks perforate its body, with small fungal stalks poking through.

mon_ant_fungus.name: fungal ant
mon_ant_fungus.description: Pale, sickly gray in color, this giant ant's cracked exoskeleton is barely held together by coils of fungus erupting from every joint in its body.

mon_spider_fungus.name: fungal spider
mon_spider_fungus.description: The abdomen of this sickly looking giant spider is now home to many lumps of blooming fungi.  It is leaving behind a trail of tainted secretions when the spider struggles to drag it along the ground.

mon_dark_wyrm.name: dark wyrm
mon_dark_wyrm.description: A huge mutated worm found deep underground.  It has a gaping round mouth lined with dagger-like teeth, and its flesh is slick with bubbling blue slime.

mon_graboid.name: graboid
mon_graboid.description: A monstrous beast the size of a semi truck with a tripartite mouth that opens to reveal hundreds of writhing tongues with razor sharp edges.  It keeps most of its enormous body hidden underground.

mon_halfworm.name: half worm
mon_halfworm.description: A squiggling severed portion of a wounded giant worm.

mon_worm.name: giant worm
mon_worm.description: An enormous, mutated creature that might once have been a nightcrawler.  It possesses a large fanged mouth and a long slender body that comes up to your shoulder, with even more surely hiding underground.

mon_skittering_plague.name: skittering plague
mon_skittering_plague.description: A giant infected roach, it has been feeding on the undead.

mon_plague_nymph.name: plague nymph
mon_plague_nymph.description: An infected mutant cockroach about the size of a rat.

mon_plague_vector.name: plague vector
mon_plague_vector.description: This infected roach has been feeding on the undead and started to mutate chaotically.  Extra limbs and growths sprout from its thorax.

mon_giant_cockroach.name: giant cockroach
mon_giant_cockroach.description: A mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.

mon_giant_cockroach_nymph.name: giant cockroach nymph
mon_giant_cockroach_nymph.description: A baby mutant cockroach about the size of a rat.

mon_pregnant_giant_cockroach.name: pregnant giant cockroach
mon_pregnant_giant_cockroach.description: A mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.  Its abdomen is heavily swollen.

mon_bee.name: giant bee
mon_bee.description: With a stinger the size of a kitchen knife, this dog-sized insect's black and yellow markings warn you to leave it undisturbed.

mon_centipede_small.name: centipede
mon_centipede_small.description: A brightly colored mutant centipede the size of a small dog, skittering quickly in the underbrush.  Probably won't think you're suitable prey, but beware its venom.

mon_centipede_giant.name: giant centipede
mon_centipede_giant.description: A two meter long centipede with a menacing set of venom-dripping mandibles and a worrying number of grabbing appendages, moving swiftly on dozens of spindly legs.  It has a pair of small compound eyes, but seems to mostly orient itself with its antennae.

mon_centipede_mom.name: centipede matriarch
mon_centipede_mom.description: A giant centipede grown even larger, hind segments curled up to protect a huge clump of eggs and its children of different ages.  Sometimes one of its young gets shaken off by its clutchmates and disappears into the underbrush.

special_attacks.monster_message: A small centipede is shaken off in the struggle!

mon_centipede_mega.name: armored centipede
mon_centipede_mega.description: A huge mutated centipede covered in interlocking chitinous plates of metallic grey, reminding you more of a runaway train car than any living animal.  Its mandibles end in jagged points, seemingly specialized to hunt prey at least as well-armored as itself.  You really don't want to try if you'd fare better.

mon_firefly.name: firefly
mon_firefly.description: A mutated firefly grown to the size of a large housecat, brightly glowing abdomen bobbing up and down as it tries to impress its unseen mate.  It looks strangely uninterested in you and everything else.

mon_dragonfly_naiad.name: huge dragonfly naiad
mon_dragonfly_naiad.description: The predatory, aquatic larva of a dragonfly, normally barely a centimeter long and feeding on small fishes, has grown to the size of a catfish.  Its folded lower jaw displays sharp mandibles resembling barbed spears.

mon_dragonfly_giant.name: giant dragonfly
mon_dragonfly_giant.description: A ferocious, bright green dragonfly, still lightning-fast despite growing to the size of a schoolchild.  Its head is little more than a basketball-sized pair of rainbow compound eyes, and its legs - already specialized for grasping prey - end in curved talons.

mon_dragonfly_mega.name: mega dragonfly
mon_dragonfly_mega.description: A single, enormous insect with a swollen abdomen and a distended ovipositor, periodically dropping a handful of glistening eggs.

mon_fly.name: giant fly
mon_fly.description: A tremendous housefly the size of a small dog, predictably accompanied by a loud, incessant buzzing sound.

mon_mosquito_giant.name: giant mosquito
mon_mosquito_giant.description: An enormous mutant mosquito, fluttering erratically.  Its face is dominated by a long, spear-tipped proboscis.

mon_spider_cellar_giant.name: giant cellar spider
mon_spider_cellar_giant.description: A twitchy mutant brown spider, with a relatively small body and spindly long legs.  Its smaller brethren are known for being agile, and for preying upon other spiders.

mon_spider_cellar_giant_s.name: immature giant cellar spider
mon_spider_cellar_giant_s.description: A newly-hatched giant cellar spider.  Too small to possess much venom, but still quick and agile like an adult.

mon_spider_jumping_giant.name: giant jumping spider
mon_spider_jumping_giant.description: A giant spider with big forelegs and two pairs of inquisitive-looking eyes.  It can leap quite quickly, even into the treetops.

mon_spider_trapdoor_giant.name: giant trapdoor spider
mon_spider_trapdoor_giant.description: A gigantic spider with a bulbous thorax.  It digs a deep underground burrow that serves as a pit to trap unwary prey.

mon_spider_web.name: giant web spider
mon_spider_web.description: A giant mutated grass spider, it waits for prey to become ensnared in the vast webs that it weaves between the trees.

mon_spider_web_s.name: immature giant web spider
mon_spider_web_s.description: A still immature giant grass spider.  Too young to be venomous, or to walk proficiently for that matter

mon_spider_widow_giant.name: giant black widow
mon_spider_widow_giant.description: A giant mutated black widow spider.  A highly venomous nightmare come to life.

mon_spider_widow_giant_s.name: giant black widow spiderling
mon_spider_widow_giant_s.description: The horrid spawn of a giant black widow spider.  Even as a newborn, this foul creature knows only how to kill.

mon_spider_wolf_giant.name: giant wolf spider
mon_spider_wolf_giant.description: A wolf spider mutated to about thirty times its normal size, it moves quickly and aggressively to catch and consume prey.

mon_wasp_larva.name: wasp larva
mon_wasp_larva.description: A white grub the size of a large cat, featureless apart from a vestigal mouthpart.  It hangs upside-down in its cell, and regurgitates sweet-smelling fluid in return for the scraps of viscera fed to it by the workers below.

mon_wasp_pupa.name: wasp pupa
mon_wasp_pupa.description: A wasp larva undergoing metamorphosis into a full-grown giant wasp.  It looks like a strangely immobile adult coated in a thin white membrane, its legs and wings packed tightly into its cell.

mon_wasp_small.name: wasp
mon_wasp_small.description: A slender-bodied flying insect, with a painful sting.  They can be somewhat aggressive if disturbed.

mon_wasp_small_guard.name: wasp guard
mon_wasp_small_guard.description: A mutated wasp worker, buzzing around their nest.  While their foraging sisters are relatively content to leave you be, this one won't hesitate to attack anything it considers a threat to the nest.  Don't linger.

mon_wasp_queen.name: wasp queen
mon_wasp_queen.description: A mutated wasp queen grown to the size of a person, laying a single white egg in each empty cell it comes across while scurrying around on the paper walls of their home.  It struggles to fit into some of them, but the newer cells seem to be getting larger…

mon_wasp.name: giant wasp
mon_wasp.description: A gigantic wasp worker, scouring the landscape for an easy meal to feed the next generation.  Its abdomen glowers with ominous yellow stripes and ends in a half-hidden stinger the size of a kitchen knife.

mon_wasp_guard.name: giant wasp guard
mon_wasp_guard.description: A wasp worker grown to the size of a person, buzzing around their home.  While their foraging sisters are relatively content to live and let live, this one won't hesitate to attack anything it considers a threat to the nest.  Don't linger.

mon_wasp_mega.name: giant wasp queen
mon_wasp_mega.description: A yellowjacket queen grown to the size of a horse, towering over their daughters.  Even with their abdomen swollen with eggs and wings long unused it still poses a threat to interlopers, should their children have failed at subduing them.

mon_wasp_mega_acid.name: giant acidic wasp queen
mon_wasp_mega_acid.description: A yellowjacket queen grown to the size of a horse, towering over their daughters.  Even worse, it's skin seems to have taken on a green hue, and bubbling acid seems to drip from its stinger.

mon_dermatik.name: dermatik
mon_dermatik.description: A colorful parasitoid wasp grown to the size of a dog, with a huge ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  It darts around in search of a suitable home for her many, many children.

mon_dermatik_larva.name: dermatik larva
mon_dermatik_larva.description: A fat white grub as big as a squirrel, with a pair of large, spadelike mandibles.

mon_dermatik_midwife.name: dermatik midwife
mon_dermatik_midwife.description: A dermatik grown even larger, its wings and ovipositor chewed off by her sisters.  It now stands watch in the nest, tending to the unfortunate hosts dragged home and ensuring they don't perish before their purpose is fulfilled.

mon_dermatik_incubator_deer.name: motionless deer
mon_dermatik_incubator_deer.description: A paralyzed, emaciated deer.  It spasms as it notices your presence, terrified eyes darting around the muddy chamber when it fails to stand and flee.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s kicks its leg happily as you scratch it.

mon_dermatik_incubator_dog.name: helpless dog
mon_dermatik_incubator_dog.description: A barely living dog, panting in a pool of slime and blood.  As you draw near it lets out a faint whimper, and you see the smallest hint of a twitch in its tail.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s kicks its leg happily as you scratch it.

mon_dermatik_incubator_spider.name: twitching spider
mon_dermatik_incubator_spider.description: A giant, mutated spider lying on its back, legs twitching without pause.  A translucent slime, mixed with its ichor seeps from its joints, and its chitin is marked by numerous exit wounds.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s kicks its leg happily as you scratch it.

mon_ant.name: giant ant
mon_ant.description: An enormous red ant covered in chitinous plates.  It possesses a pair of wriggling antennae and vicious-looking mandibles.

mon_ant_acid.name: giant acidic ant
mon_ant_acid.description: A monstrous brown ant with a swollen abdomen, that ends with a small orifice at the tip.  Glistening liquid seems to drip out periodically.

mon_ant_acid_larva.name: acidic ant larva
mon_ant_acid_larva.description: A squirming yellow grub that seems to be oozing liquid from both ends of its body.  It appears its chitin hasn't developed enough to resist acid.

mon_ant_acid_queen.name: acidic queen ant
mon_ant_acid_queen.description: An enormous brown ant with an elongated, pulsating abdomen.  Its orifice seems developed only for egg-laying rather than spraying acid like the rest of the colony, but it doesn't seem affected by the acrid liquid either.

mon_ant_acid_soldier.name: acidic soldier ant
mon_ant_acid_soldier.description: A massive woolly brown ant that towers over the worker ants with a giant head crest.  Along with its huge mandibles, a corrosive liquid seeps from the end of its bloated abdomen.

mon_ant_larva.name: ant larva
mon_ant_larva.description: A pulsating sausage of glistening white flesh, the size of a large cat.  On one end is a set of squirming mouth parts.

mon_ant_queen.name: queen ant
mon_ant_queen.description: A colossal red ant with a bulging, bloated thorax.  It moves slowly and deliberately, tending to nearby eggs and continually laying more.

mon_ant_soldier.name: soldier ant
mon_ant_soldier.description: A huge and hairy red ant almost twice the size of other giant ants.  Bulging pincers extend from its jaws.

mon_locust.name: giant locust
mon_locust.description: An overgrown locust.  You don't think it'll eat you but it could cause massive damage to nearby plants.

mon_locust_nymph.name: locust nymph
mon_locust_nymph.description: A locust the size of a rabbit.  You'd hate to think what a swarm of these could do.

mon_fleshy_shambler.name: fleshy shambler
mon_fleshy_shambler.description: An amalgamation of throbbing organs from various creatures have fused together into this lurching, vaguely humanoid shape.  Its myriad roughly formed mouths sussurate in a chorus of sibilant groans and whispers.

mon_flesh_golem.name: flesh golem
mon_flesh_golem.description: A seeping conglomeration of spasming muscle and organs have fused together into this towering caricature of the human form.  Various organs fall off of its hulking body only to be reabsorbed moments later.

mon_jabberwock.name: jabberwock
mon_jabberwock.description: A putrid amalgamation of body parts from humans and other creatures have fused together in this aberration of flesh.  The eyes of all the heads dart about rapidly and the mouths form a chorus of groaning screams.

mon_bat_pup.name: bat pup
mon_bat_pup.description: One of the vesper bats, a family of winged insect-eating mammals.  This one seems very young.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s flies around you, screeching a song of friendship.

mon_bat.name: bat
mon_bat.description: One of the vesper bats, a family of winged insect-eating mammals.  It roosts in caves and other hollows, and uses a form of echolocation to aerially navigate through tricky terrain at rapid speeds.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s flies around you, screeching a song of friendship.

mon_bat_vampire.name: vampire bat
mon_bat_vampire.description: One of the Desmodontinae bats, a family of winged blood-eating mammals.  It roosts in caves and other hollows, and uses a form of echolocation to aerially navigate through tricky terrain at rapid speeds.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s flies around you, screeching a song of friendship.

mon_bat_vampire_mutant.name: mutant vampire bat
mon_bat_vampire_mutant.description: One of the Desmodontinae bats, a family of winged blood-eating mammals.  This one looks terribly larger and stronger than its other kin.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s flies around you, screeching a song of friendship.

mon_bear_cub.name: black bear cub
mon_bear_cub.description: A juvenile American black bear.  This one isn't much of a threat, but be wary of its parent; black bears are known for their protectiveness.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s looks at you with big puppy eyes.

mon_bear.name: black bear
mon_bear.description: The American black bear.  A large omnivorous scavenger, it has powerful claws and jaws, and is an effective ambush hunter.  Most individuals are shy around humans, but they're fiercely protective of their cubs.

mon_beaver.name: beaver
mon_beaver.description: The North American beaver, the continent's largest rodent.  Its paddle-shaped tail helps ferry it through the water, and its prominent teeth can chew through wood, which it uses to build dam-like nests in lakes and streams.

mon_black_rat.name: black rat
mon_black_rat.description: The black rat, an omnivorous rodent with sheer black fur and a long, rough tail.  Harbinger of pestilence, famine, and mange, it will sometimes swarm over the dead or dying.

mon_boar_wild_piglet.name: wild boar piglet
mon_boar_wild_piglet.description: Originally not native in the US, this wild omnivore is a crossbreed between the Eurasian wild boar escaped from hunting reserves and the domesticated pig went feral in the wilderness.  Its population has skyrocketed in the US during the last few decades.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s squeals happily at you.

mon_boar_wild.name: wild boar
mon_boar_wild.description: Originally not native in the US, this wild omnivore is a crossbreed between the Eurasian wild boar escaped from hunting reserves and the domesticated pig went feral in the wilderness.  Its population has skyrocketed in the US during the last few decades.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!
petfood.pet: The %s squeals happily at you.

mon_bobcat.name: bobcat
mon_bobcat.description: A spotted wild cat living across much of North America.  It is not a serious threat to humans, but it can be aggressive when threatened.

mon_cat_kitten.name: shorthair kitten
mon_cat_kitten.description: A cuddly kitten meowing and scampering amidst the death.  Currently feral.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat.name: shorthair cat
mon_cat.description: A small domesticated predator gone feral in the absence of human stewardship.  Harried by the elements and the rigors of survival, it is scruffy and skittish.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_longhair.name: longhair cat
mon_cat_longhair.description: This cat's long fur appears difficult to groom, but the cat seems to manage it despite the environmental conditions.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_longhair_kitten.name: longhair kitten
mon_cat_longhair_kitten.description: Barely more than a ball of fluff with eyes, this kitten looks like a longhair breed.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_maine_coon.name: Maine Coon cat
mon_cat_maine_coon.description: Impressively large for a domestic cat, this thick-haired breed was once native to the state of Maine.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_maine_coon_kitten.name: Maine Coon kitten
mon_cat_maine_coon_kitten.description: This young Maine coon has tufted ears and a striking pattern on its face.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_siamese.name: Siamese cat
mon_cat_siamese.description: This cat has the distinctive dark extremeties of a Siamese, first native to Asia but a common domestic breed in North America.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_siamese_kitten.name: Siamese kitten
mon_cat_siamese_kitten.description: With cream-colored fur and dark points, you guess this kitten must be a young Siamese.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_persian.name: Persian cat
mon_cat_persian.description: The short nose and rounded face of this cat suggest it comes from the popular Persian breed.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_persian_kitten.name: Persian kitten

It lacks any integral weaponry, but the user can fire from the open cockpit, even using the frame to support heavier firearms.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot. mon_mi_go_surgeon.name: mi-go surgeon

mon_mi_go_guard.name: mi-go guard

Its trunk is a shapeless mass of strange flesh encased in an iridescent carapace, from which sprout several appendages terminating in what appear to be devices of some sort.  Its pyramidal head is encrusted in barnacle-like armor, aside from the bristling antennae that serve as its - you must assume sensory devices and mouth.

mon_mi_go_myrmidon.name: mi-go myrmidon
mon_mi_go_myrmidon.description: This creature resembles the smaller mi-go like a grizzly bear resembles a human.  Its enormous, thick body is covered in an iridescent segmented carapace, like a scarab crossed with an isopod.  It boasts several pairs of deadly looking claws and other appendages, and it moves with a strange, slow grace, like an otherworldly dancer.  It actually appears to be carrying weaponry.

mon_mi_go_scout.description: This slender mi-go is a little smaller than most others of its kind. debug_mon_armored.description: This monster exists only for testing purposes.  It's used in the DPS calculations for Armored.

debug_mon_mixed.name: mixed debug monster
debug_mon_mixed.description: This monster exists only for testing purposes.  It's used in the DPS calculations for Mixed.

mon_dragon_dummy.name: ancient red dragon
mon_dragon_dummy.description: A towering, hulking dragon, with tremendous, curving horns and shining red scales, its glowing maw peeled back in a hateful grimace as its eyes bore into yours.

mon_generator.name: generator
mon_generator.description: Your precious generator, noisily humming away.  Defend it at all costs!

mon_hallu_multicooker.name: evil multi-cooker
mon_hallu_multicooker.description: The multi-cooker's got a mind of its own!  Look out!

mon_hologram.name: hologram
mon_hologram.description: An image made from light, nearly identical to the real deal.

mon_cat_mutant_prism.name: iridescent cat
mon_cat_mutant_prism.description: As it moves, this cat's colors shift unnaturally in the light.  You can't make out the breed, but its fur pattern seems to change with every step.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_mutant_kitten_prism.name: iridescent kitten
mon_cat_mutant_kitten_prism.description: In the light, this adorably tiny bundle of unkempt fluff is an ever-changing flurry of brilliant colors.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_void_kitten.name: void kitten
mon_cat_void_kitten.description: This black ball of fur seems to absorb the light from its surroundings while looking criminally cute.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_void.name: void cat
mon_cat_void.description: Seeing how unnaturally dark this black cat's fur is, you are certain this is no ordinary cat.  Its fur seems to absorb light from the surroundings.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s sofly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_bear_armored.name: scaled bear
mon_bear_armored.description: This bear is covered in large, black, scales.  It seems to have slight problems turning around, but its sinuous movement is no slower than that of normal bears.

mon_bear_mutant_3headed.name: Cerbearus
mon_bear_mutant_3headed.description: Sometime between the Cataclysm and now, this black bear has gained two extra heads.  This doesn't seem to have improved its disposition.

mon_beaver_mutant_huge.name: dambreaker
mon_beaver_mutant_huge.description: This mutated beaver's size is almost double what it should be, and its back is covered with tough-looking bristles.

mon_beaver_mutant_avian.name: feaver
mon_beaver_mutant_avian.description: This mutant beaver's body is covered with brightly-colored feathers in a particularly eyecatching pattern.  It must have been very lucky not to have been caught by a predator before now.

mon_coyote_mutant_shark.name: grinning coyote
mon_coyote_mutant_shark.description: Were it not for the misshapen snout and visible teeth, this would look like an ordinary Northeastern coyote.  Closer inspection of its mouth reveals row after row of serrated, shark-like teeth.

mon_coyote_mutant_venom.name: slavering coyote
mon_coyote_mutant_venom.description: Unnatural bulges line the neck of this obviously-mutated coyote; green-tinted foam flecks from its lips, and there's a crazed look in its eyes.

mon_wolf_mutant_huge.name: dire wolf
mon_wolf_mutant_huge.description: This wolf has grown to terrifying proportions, rivaling a small car.  Its teeth give steak knives a run for their money, and it definitely doesn't look friendly.

mon_deer_mutant_spider.name: spideer
mon_deer_mutant_spider.description: This once-ordinary deer has grown a disturbingly agile array of extra limbs, plus three extra eyes.  Its antlers wriggle subtly in the wind.

mon_deer_mutant_spider_fawn.name: spideer fawn
mon_deer_mutant_spider_fawn.description: This obviously mutated adolescent deer moves unsteadily on its eight legs, nervously scanning the area with all five eyes.

mon_dog_mutant_mongrel.name: mongrel
mon_dog_mutant_mongrel.description: This dog of unidentifiable breed looks like it has seen better days.  Its wiry hair is patchy, revealing scales underneath, but it still happily wags its tails anyways.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat their head.

mon_mutant_crawler.name: shadow stinger
mon_mutant_crawler.description: This giant scorpion-like creature is the result of wanton experimentation combined with the conditions of the cataclysm.  It seems to be shrouded in a cloak of darkness, and a menacing stinger hangs over its beady black eyes.

mon_chud.name: C.H.U.D.
mon_chud.description: The C.H.U.D. or Cannibalistic Humanoid Underground Dweller.  A human being turned pale and mad from years of underground isolation.

mon_mutant_experimental.name: experimental mutant
mon_mutant_experimental.description: A deformed amalgamation of man and animal.  Grotesque humanoid covered in fur and a torn jumpsuit.  The sinister fangs, claws and the look of insanity in his pale yellow eyes are a testament to that he lost all of his humanity.

mon_mutant_evolved.name: evolved mutant
mon_mutant_evolved.description: A towering beast that is neither human nor animal anymore.  A malformed, huge creature covered in thick fur and the torn bottom part of a jumpsuit.  The sinister fangs, claws and the look of insanity in his pale yellow eyes are a testament to that he lost all of his humanity.

mon_one_eye.name: cyclopean
mon_one_eye.description: A relatively humanoid mutant with purple hair and a grapefruit-sized bloodshot eye.

mon_mutant_alpha.name: alpha mutant
mon_mutant_alpha.description: A tall human wearing a yellow jumpsuit with toned muscles and perfect skin.  They seem to radiate a sense of perfection, and just being in their presence makes you feel inferior.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mutant stares straight into your eyes, and you can't help but feel drawn towards it...

mon_mutant_medical.name: medical mutant
mon_mutant_medical.description: A disfigured human wearing the tattered remains of a yellow jumpsuit, bearing a dead expression and lightless eyes.  They twitch and jerk around frantically, as if in great fear, yet their face betrays no emotion.

special_attacks.monster_message: You suddenly feel as if you're seeing through the mutant's eyes, and nightmarish figures appear!

mon_mutant_medical_summon.name: nightmarish hallucination
mon_mutant_medical_summon.description: This terrifying black figure's indescribable features shift constantly and erratically.

special_attacks.monster_message: The figure vanishes and reappears!

mon_mutant_medical_summon_hostile.name: nightmarish hallucination
mon_mutant_medical_summon_hostile.description: This terrifying black figure's indescribable features shift constantly and erratically.

special_attacks.monster_message: The figure vanishes and reappears!

mon_mutant_elfa_decoy.name: elf-a mutant
mon_mutant_elfa_decoy.description: A tall humanoid with striking green features, crowned by blooming roses which seem to blend in to their golden hair.  Nature radiates from the being, who stares at you kindly with glowing green eyes.

special_attacks.monster_message: A booming voice echoes through your mind: "Why do you attack me? I only wish to live in communion with nature!"

mon_mutant_elfa.name: elf-a mutant
mon_mutant_elfa.description: A tall humanoid with striking green features, crowned by blooming roses which seem to blend in to their golden hair.  The being glares at you with nature's wrath.

special_attacks.monster_message: The elf-a mutant vanishes into the nature around it, and an angry protector appears from the woodwork!

special_attacks.description: The elf-a mutant lets loose an arrow!

mon_mutant_elfa_protector.name: woodland guardian
mon_mutant_elfa_protector.description: A large black bear charmed by the elf-a mutant.  A large omnivorous scavenger, it has powerful claws and jaws, and is an effective ambush hunter.  Most individuals are shy around humans, but this one seems fully aggressive under the spell of its master.

mon_albino_penguin.name: albino penguin
mon_albino_penguin.description: Eight-feet-tall ghastly white penguins.  Placid unless otherwise provoked.

mon_amigara_horror.name: amigara horror
mon_amigara_horror.description: A hellish, vaguely humanoid horror, two stories tall.  Its face is grotesquely stretched out, its limbs deformed to unrecognizable outgrowths.

mon_blank.name: blank body
mon_blank.description: This is some form of unnatural changeling creature; its appearance is a bland mockery of the human form.  Featureless and pale, its repugnant countenance is all the more unsettling due to its lack of eyes and distinguishing features except for a perfectly round mouth.  Naked and trembling, it almost seems pitiful.

mon_blood_sacrifice.name: blood sacrifice
mon_blood_sacrifice.description: A defiled human body, once living.  Tortured to death long ago, it remains chained to the altar, the putrescent flays of its peeled skin quivering like so much flotsam upon a murky pond.

mon_breather.name: breather
mon_breather.description: This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.

mon_breather_hub.name: breather
mon_breather_hub.description: A weird mass of immobile pink goo.  It seems to breathe.

mon_darkman.name: wraith
mon_darkman.description: A gigantic shadow, chaotically changing in shape and volume.  Two piercing orbs of light dominate what can only be described as its head.

mon_dementia.name: dementia
mon_dementia.description: A crazed individual, the bloody scars on the side of its shaved head suggest some sort of partial lobotomy

mon_dog_thing.name: dog
mon_dog_thing.description: A domesticated mongrel of the canine persuasion.  In the absence of human society, it has turned feral.  You feel a sudden urge to destroy it.

petfood.feed: If you're seeing this message it's a bug.
petfood.pet: If you're seeing this message it's a bug.

mon_flaming_eye.name: flaming eye
mon_flaming_eye.description: An enormous disembodied eyeball the size of a person, flying through the air through some unknown agency.  Wreathed in unnatural flickering blue flame, it possesses a blazing yellow iris with a slitted pupil like that of a cat and trails a set of flailing black tendrils as it slowly drifts about.  A baleful gaze seems to emanate from it.

mon_flesh_angel.name: flesh angel
mon_flesh_angel.description: A tall and slender man lacking skin and any normalcy of countenance.  Wings of muscle curl forth from its back and a third eye dominates the forehead.

mon_flying_polyp.name: flying polyp
mon_flying_polyp.description: A half polypous, utterly alien creature.  It's only partly material and has the ability to fly, despite the absence of wings.  The air swirling around it gives the impression of breathing or whistling, in a tone too high for most humans to hear.

mon_gozu.name: gozu
mon_gozu.description: This is some sort of unnatural cross between a bull and a man.  Quite different from the minotaur of legend, it possesses a shaggy white bull’s head on an otherwise unremarkable human body.  Clad in tattered remnants of clothing, it grunts and snuffles, frothing at the mouth like a rabid animal.

mon_gracke.name: gracken
mon_gracke.description: This is some form of eldritch monstrosity; an uncouth black being with smooth, oily, skin and unpleasant horns that curve inward toward each other.  Tall and thin, the shadows cling unnaturally to its vaguely defined humanoid form as it shuffles along, its hands twitching and spasming so rapidly as to appear a little more than a black blur of claws.

mon_headless_dog_thing.name: tentacle dog
mon_headless_dog_thing.description: A dog's body with a mass of ropey, black tentacles reaching out from its head.

mon_homunculus.name: homunculus
mon_homunculus.description: A pale hairless man with an impressive athletic physique.  Its lidless eyes are totally black, and seeping with blood.

mon_hound_tindalos.name: hound of tindalos
mon_hound_tindalos.description: A grotesque hound-like beast, its frame is angular and emaciated and its head is like that of an abyssal fish.  When it moves, twisted limbs duplicate, merge, disappear, and reform in dissonance, as if a hundred copies of itself were somehow forced to inhabit the same space.  Extraneous to our reality, it moves between the corners of the world, hunting those that would dare stepping beyond time and space.

mon_hound_tindalos_afterimage.name: hound of tindalos
mon_hound_tindalos_afterimage.description: A grotesque hound-like beast, its frame is angular and emaciated and its head is like that of an abyssal fish.  When it moves, twisted limbs duplicate, merge, disappear, and reform in dissonance, as if a hundred copies of itself were somehow forced to inhabit the same space.  Extraneous to our reality, it moves between the corners of the world, hunting those that would dare stepping beyond time and space.

mon_human_snail.name: human snail
mon_human_snail.description: An enormous fleshy snail, with an oddly human face.  Eyestalks protrude from where the eyes should be.

mon_hunting_horror.name: hunting horror
mon_hunting_horror.description: This is some sort of great viperine creature, possessed of a curiously distorted head and massive clawed appendages.  It partially supports itself with the aid of black rubbery wings of monstrous dimensions.

mon_kreck.name: kreck
mon_kreck.description: This is some form of otherworldly hound.  Lean and hungry looking, its twisted red flesh is stretched tightly across its misshapen, angular frame.  Loping grotesquely along, its unusually long neck stretches forward, its skull-like head near the ground as it sniffs out its prey.

mon_mothman.name: lepidopterid
mon_mothman.description: A humanoid figure flitting about on what appears to be multiple pairs of insectoid wings.  Its outline is obscured by a pitch-black haze surrounding it, a faint glimmer of glowing eyes evident.

special_attacks.monster_message: Creeping darkness radiates from %s!

mon_shadow.name: shadow
mon_shadow.description: This is an animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany its quiet murmurs.

mon_shadow_snake.name: shadow snake
mon_shadow_snake.description: This is an animate shadow in the form of a long and sinuous snake.  Translucent and dark, it glides silently across the floor, wriggling and flexing as it moves.

mon_shoggoth.name: shoggoth
mon_shoggoth.description: A gargantuan protoplasmic blob, constantly reshaping, forming new pseudopods seemingly at will.  All over its body are eyes that form and disappear.  It looks at you with malice.

mon_thing.name: thing
mon_thing.description: An amorphous black creature, detaching and sprouting tentacles without any apparent pause.

mon_twisted_body.name: twisted body
mon_twisted_body.description: A human body, but with its limbs, neck, and hair impossibly twisted.  It clambers around swiftly, making awful screeching sounds.

mon_yugg.name: yugg
mon_yugg.description: This is a huge, slimy worm-like creature.  Its pale, flattened head drips an oily mucus as it breaches the ground, searching for prey.  Its pinkish mouth opens and closes, revealing long fangs glistening with ropey strands of saliva, which leave smoldering stains wherever they drip.

mon_vortex.name: vortex
mon_vortex.description: A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

mon_shade_boss.name: shaded figure
mon_shade_boss.description: This suit of advanced protective clothing clearly encases something, but you're sure that whatever it is, it is no longer human.  The blurry figure shifts around erratically, as if barely corporeal.

special_attacks.monster_message: The figure suddenly disappears and multiplies!

mon_shade_boss_clone.name: shaded figure
mon_shade_boss_clone.description: This suit of advanced protective clothing clearly encases something, but you're sure that whatever it is, it is no longer human.  The blurry figure shifts around erratically, as if barely corporeal.

mon_suspended_shade.name: suspended shade
mon_suspended_shade.description: This blurry, dark figure, wearing the outline of what can barely be perceived as a lab coat, shifts around your view erratically, perpetually out of focus.  It floats motionlessly, as if impaled by invisible spikes.  Paradoxically, it seems to be emitting light...

mon_suspended_merc.name: suspended task force
mon_suspended_merc.description: This figure, suspended motionless in the air, is clad in hazmat gear and armor.  Around it orbits a swarm of shell casings and fired bullets.

special_attacks.monster_message: A swarm of casings and bullets breaks off from the swarm and flies towards you!

mon_suspended_merc_summon.name: shrapnel swarm
mon_suspended_merc_summon.description: This swarm of metal is made of various casings, fired bullets, and shrapnel.  The swarm orbits around a central, invisible force at high speed, and it seems to be heading towards you.

mon_anomaly_boss.name: PE-025-X
mon_anomaly_boss.description: This anomaly resembles a floating ball of plasma.  It looks entirely inert.

special_attacks.monster_message: Copies of PE-025-X manifest around it!

mon_anomaly_boss_clone.name: PE-025-X
mon_anomaly_boss_clone.description: Rocks and rubble churn at high speed around a central dark mass.  Luckily, it seems this anomaly can actually be harmed conventionally.

special_attacks.description: A heavy rock flies off from the anomaly!

special_attacks.monster_message: Vengeful shades appear around you, coming to your aid!

mon_task_force_shade.name: vengeful shade
mon_task_force_shade.description: This shifting figure dons a suit of hazmat gear under it's heavy armor, over which it wears a large harness which reads '025-XPE'.  Despite its striking appearance, it seems to be focused instead on the anomalies around it.  It may be your only hope to finally stop this anomaly.

special_attacks.description: The vengeful shade fires their rifle!

mon_leech_blossom.name: leech blossom
mon_leech_blossom.description: A resplendent alien fern, crowned with flowers colored deep indigo.  It appears to be the centerpiece of this otherworldly bloom.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the leech blossom!

mon_leech_stalk.name: leech stalk
mon_leech_stalk.description: A resplendent and voluminous alien fern.  A faint buzzing sound emanates from it, and the shadow cast by its canopy continuously glows with electric charge.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the leech stalk!

mon_leech_radio.name: signal tree
mon_leech_radio.description: A trunk stretches out into the air, its topmost branches glowing with yellow light.  A low drum periodically shakes the vicinity.

special_attacks.monster_message: The signal tree's branches flicker and let off a dazzling pulse!

mon_leech_pod_cluster.name: leech pod cluster
mon_leech_pod_cluster.description: The translucent egg pods of an alien plant, firmly attached by luminous rhizomes.  You can barely distinguish a root drone floating within a cloudy substance.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the pod cluster!

mon_leech_root_runner.name: root runner
mon_leech_root_runner.description: This clump of woody vegetation hastily clambers around in a lizard-like fashion.  Three translucent scale-leaves stand tall on the backside of the creature, and the thin ridges within them periodically glow through some unknown mean.  It's seemingly a symbiote of the nearby alien ferns, and looks ready to defend them with its life.

special_attacks.description: Sparks fly from the root runner!

mon_leech_root_drone.name: root drone
mon_leech_root_drone.description: A small bulb with a beak-like protuberance, skittishly roaming about under three tendril rhizomes.  Dripping and glistening, it resembles a creature newly born rather than a sapling grown from seeds.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the root pod!

mon_frog_giant.name: giant frog
mon_frog_giant.description: A mutated bullfrog taller than you are.  It stares with amber eyes as it considers the easiest way to swallow you whole.

mon_gator.name: sewer gator
mon_gator.description: Old urban legends talked about pet alligators getting flushed down the toilet and growing to adulthood in sewers.  More recently, gators have been seen migrating farther north as climate change drives them to adapt or die.  Wherever it came from, this large specimen doesn't look like it sees humans as anything other than a meal.

mon_rattlesnake.name: rattlesnake
mon_rattlesnake.description: The timber rattlesnake is the most venomous viper native to New England.  Climatic changes have extended its range far into the north.

mon_rattlesnake_giant.name: giant rattlesnake
mon_rattlesnake_giant.description: A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.

mon_sewer_snake.name: sewer snake
mon_sewer_snake.description: An aggressive mutant variety of the worm snake, turned pale yellow from its underground life.  It swarms beneath the ground and is named for its habit of infesting sewer lines, but sometimes these creatures escape the storm drains and get washed downstream into other waterways.

mon_blob.name: blob
mon_blob.description: A black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.

mon_blob_brain.name: brain blob
mon_blob_brain.description: A gigantic black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.  Other blobs seem to swarm around it.

mon_blob_large.name: big blob
mon_blob_large.description: A large black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.

mon_blob_carpet.name: black carpet
mon_blob_carpet.description: A large black blob of viscous goo, spread thin like a rug across the ground, as if its once massive form has been stretched and flattened to cover more space. The surface shimmers with an oily sheen, and it pulses faintly, its edges eternally creeping ever so slowly.

mon_blob_small.name: small blob
mon_blob_small.description: A small black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.

mon_gelatin.name: amoebic mold
mon_gelatin.description: A formless slime mold the size of a cow.  Crusty bits of cytoplasm fall away as it oozes across the ground.

mon_player_blob.name: slimespring
mon_player_blob.description: A familiar-looking blob of goo.  It sprouts the occasional eyestalk.

mon_sludge_crawler.name: sludge crawler
mon_sludge_crawler.description: A sluglike creature, eight feet long and the width of a refrigerator.  Its black body glistens as it oozes its way along the ground.  Eye stalks occasionally push their way out of the oily mass and look around.

mon_slug_giant.name: giant slug
mon_slug_giant.description: A mutated leopard slug, as wide as a golf cart.  Venom dripping from its fanged maw, it slithers ahead slowly, leaving a trail of glistening slime.

mon_biollante_sprig.name: biollante sprig
mon_biollante_sprig.description: A short fat stalk with broad leaves and tiny flower buds.

mon_biollante_sprout.name: biollante sprout
mon_biollante_sprout.description: A thick stalk that rises five feet from the ground and has heavy broad leaves at its base.  Purple flower buds adorn the top.

mon_biollante.name: biollante
mon_biollante.description: A drooped, quivering plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are closed, and pulsate ominously.

mon_creeper_hub.name: creeper hub
mon_creeper_hub.description: A thick stalk, rooted to the ground.  It rapidly sprouts thorny vines in all directions.

mon_creeper_vine.name: creeper vine
mon_creeper_vine.description: A thorny vine, twisting wildly as it grows with incredible speed.

mon_triffid_sprig.name: triffid sprig
mon_triffid_sprig.description: A teeny-tiny triffid that has recently germinated.  Like a house cat, you know it wants to eat you but it just can't figure out how.

mon_triffid_young.name: triffid sprout
mon_triffid_young.description: A small triffid, only a few feet tall.  It has not yet developed bark, but its sting is still sharp and deadly.

mon_triffid.name: triffid
mon_triffid.description: A creeping animate plant, growing as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.

mon_triffid_queen.name: triffid queen
mon_triffid_queen.description: A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid.  It has enormous red petals surrounded by a haze of spores, and two thick barbed vines stick out from the stems like wary harpoons.

mon_vinebeast.name: vine beast
mon_vinebeast.description: An animated mass of roots and vines, creeping along the ground with alarming speed.  The tangle is thick enough that the center from which they grow is concealed.

mon_fungal_fighter.name: fungal fighter
mon_fungal_fighter.description: A stout woody plant that can dig through the ground and flick spines from its branches.  The thorns carry a fungicidal compound with paralytic effects.

mon_triffid_flower.name: triffid flower
mon_triffid_flower.description: A giant plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are open with ominous shine in center.

mon_triffid_heart.name: triffid heart
mon_triffid_heart.description: A knot of tubular roots, flowing with sap and beating like a heart.  Strands of vascular tissue reach out to the surrounding root walls.

mon_triffid_radiant_boss.name: radiant triffid
mon_triffid_radiant_boss.description: A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid, mutated by unholy experimentation.  Its enormous petals radiate glowing sunlight, which it seems to be able to focus on its enemies to devastating effect.

special_attacks.description: The triffid focuses a beam of shining light!

special_attacks.monster_message: The triffid seems to suck in the light and emits a blinding ray!

mon_turret_searchlight.name: milspec searchlight
mon_turret_searchlight.description: Three high-powered searchlights with automated search AI and mounting, continually seeking targets.

mon_laserturret.name: laser turret
