mon_laserturret.description: The TX-5LR Cerberus is an upgrade to its predecessors.  It features a state of the art revolving laser cannon system with three barrels that charge from solar cells embedded in its hull.

mon_turret_riot.name: riot control platform
mon_turret_riot.description: These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' is not the same as 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the cataclysm, massive stockrooms of the things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not so mobile anymore.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Universal curfew is in effect.  Please return to your home.  This unit is authorized to open fire."

mon_turret_light.name: light turret
mon_turret_light.description: The General Atomics TX-1 Guardian, an popular automated turret equipped with a 9mm carbine.  Initially it was designed mainly for corporate property protection and police needs, however due to its popularity, it ended up being used even for military needs.  Its high-quality targeting system allows it to engage targets even at medium range.

mon_robofac_turret_light.name: Hub 01 light turret
mon_robofac_turret_light.description: The General Atomics TX-1 Guardian, an popular automated turret equipped with a 9mm carbine.  Initially it was designed mainly for corporate property protection and police needs, however due to its popularity, it ended up being used even for military needs.  Its high-quality targeting system allows it to engage targets even at medium range.

mon_turret_medium.name: medium milspec turret
mon_turret_medium.description: The General Atomics TX-5 Sentinel, an automated milspec turret equipped with a 5.56mm gun.  A direct upgrade of original TX-1 Guardian for military use.  Designed to efficiently take down enemy personnel protected by body armor at medium range.

mon_turret_longrange.name: longrange milspec turret
mon_turret_longrange.description: The General Atomics TX-7 Sniper, an automated milspec turret equipped with a 7.62x51mm gun.  Designed as a counter-sniper turret to cover the vulnerability of TX-5 Sentinel to sniper fire.  Its advanced target recognition system and 7.62x51mm gun allows it to engage targets protected by modern body armor at very long range.

mon_turret_antimateriel.name: anti-materiel milspec turret
mon_turret_antimateriel.description: The General Atomics TX-10 Heavy, an automated milspec turret equipped with a M2HB machine gun.  Designed for light vehicles or enemies behind cover, it utilizes the powerful and ubiquitous .50 BMG.  Its advanced target recognition system and M2HB makes a deadly combination for anything short of an armored vehicle.

mon_turret_mark19.name: grenade launcher milspec turret
mon_turret_mark19.description: The General Atomics TX-12 Thumper, an automated milspec turret equipped with a MK19 grenade machine gun.  Designed for medium or light vehicles, it utilizes high velocity 40x53mm grenades.  Such a powerful device moves the bar from anything on four legs to anything on four wheels, but the minimum range and the inability to return fire as a safety measure necessitates cover fire from other turret systems.

mon_eyebot.name: eyebot
mon_eyebot.description: A quadcopter drone largely comprised of a high-resolution camera lens and a speaker, this robot hovers above the ground, documenting the carnage and mayhem around it.  While it is no longer able to report to a central authority, it's likely that some of its automated alert systems are still functional, given that the thing seems to have an operational charging station somewhere.

mon_grocerybot.name: grocery bot
mon_grocerybot.description: A popular product from Uncanny, this friendly android can carry your bag or push your Grocery Cart for you.  You know it's friendly because its human face is constantly smiling at you.  According to the ads it uses a state-machine of a complexity never seen before, Uncanny even hired professional actors to record its lines.  Examine to befriend.

mon_grocerybot_busted.name: busted grocery bot
mon_grocerybot_busted.description: A busted grocery bot, it can still carry your bag but its arms are too damaged to push a Grocery Cart.  Despite its current state it's still smiling at you.  Examine to befriend.

mon_hazmatbot.name: cleaner bot
mon_hazmatbot.description: The Ford Sanitron, a utility robot designed for cleaning up waste material in hazardous conditions.

mon_haulerbot.name: hauler bot
mon_haulerbot.description: A mule-sized, quadrupedal robot designed for commercial and military use.  Capable of carrying up to 180 kilograms (400 pounds), autonomously stumbling about and surveying the terrain with its various cameras.  Not very useful after the apocalypse, unless it has been reprogrammed to receive commands from a new user.

mon_molebot.name: miner bot
mon_molebot.description: A snake-like, segmented robot built to tunnel into the ground and detonate landmines.

mon_nursebot.name: nurse bot
mon_nursebot.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patient to assist.

mon_nursebot_defective.name: nurse bot
mon_nursebot_defective.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patient to assist.

mon_zombie_acidic.name: acidic zombie
mon_zombie_acidic.description: A sickly-looking dead one.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

mon_zombie_corrosive.name: corrosive zombie
mon_zombie_corrosive.description: This body has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated body.  It clumsily moves around, but attacks with a large reserve of acid.

special_attacks.description: The corrosive zombie spits a glob of acid!

mon_zombie_spitter.name: spitter zombie
mon_zombie_spitter.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.

mon_zombie_wretched.name: wretched puker
mon_zombie_wretched.description: A degenerate corpse, shambling as it walks.  Several junks and waste materials have unified into its skin and wounds around it reeks in black goo.

mon_zombie_acid_mortar.name: acid mortar zombie
mon_zombie_acid_mortar.description: This zombie's original face is gone, and in its place is a grotesque amalgamation of bio-mortar.  Bone and flesh extending from a swollen, cracked skull form a rounded muzzle, inside of which a constantly bubbling mass of acidic fluid boils.

special_attacks.description: The acid-artillery zombie launches a giant glob of acid!

mon_zombie_acid_spawner.name: acid spawner zombie
mon_zombie_acid_spawner.description: This zombie's head has been horribly melted and fused, its skull horribly twisted and pushed to the side by a giant, swollen, acidic egg sac.  The egg sac pulses incessantly, spewing out self-destructive acid maggots.

mon_unstable_grub.name: unstable acid grub
mon_unstable_grub.description: This unstable small creature was born from the body of an acid spawn zombie. With a horribly twisted body, the maggot is covered in sticky acid and filled with a destructive force that bubbles inside.

mon_zombie_ichor_brute.name: ichor brute
mon_zombie_ichor_brute.description: A brute zombie with muscles swollen by acidic fluid and covered in festering wounds.  It oozes a sticky slime from its melting flesh, clinging to any surface it touches.

mon_zombie_ichor_beast.name: ichor beast
mon_zombie_ichor_beast.description: A large, bloated zombie dog covered in acidic slime.  Its teeth have grown longer, and its broad back is covered in gnarled muscles and pus-filled wounds.  Its body oozes slime, notably dripping from its jaws like some nightmarish imitation of a rabid dog.

mon_zombie_ichor_stalker.name: ichor stalker
mon_zombie_ichor_stalker.description: This monster barely maintains its human form, with its joints bent at strange angles.  Bright green liquid constantly oozes from the gaps between its muscles, and it moves with surprising agility.  Its teeth and claws have transformed into sharp blades, dripping with viscous slime.

mon_zombie_child_scorched.name: zombie kinderling
mon_zombie_child_scorched.description: A tiny charred body, jumping and kicked and flailing around in a mockery of playground exercise.  It does not need a face for you to feel bad about killing it.

mon_zombie_fiend.name: fiend
mon_zombie_fiend.description: Charred zombie with bony plates, spikes and protrusions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.

mon_zombie_scorched.name: scorched zombie
mon_zombie_scorched.description: Heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred flesh.  Its flesh has mended into a leathery shell.

mon_zombie_anklebiter.name: anklebiter
mon_zombie_anklebiter.description: This horrifying little mutated wretch looks to have once been a child, but its massive gaping jaws are now far more suggestive of a predatory beast.

mon_zombie_child.name: zombie child
mon_zombie_child.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

mon_zombie_creepy.name: creepy crawler
mon_zombie_creepy.description: What was once a child is now a mutant beast with blackened skin and massive eyes.  This abomination's vile form makes mockery of its human origin.

mon_zombie_shriekling.name: shriekling
mon_zombie_shriekling.description: This heavily mutated child zombie twitches and flails its limbs in painful looking spasms as it runs about.

mon_zombie_snotgobbler.name: snotgobbler
mon_zombie_snotgobbler.description: This swollen, gooey looking mutant child looks bad, even for a zombie.  Maybe that's why it seems to want a hug so badly.

mon_zombie_sproglodyte.name: sproglodyte
mon_zombie_sproglodyte.description: This crouching child-mutant's face is dominated by a pair of huge black eyes and its fingertips end in sharp claws.

mon_zombie_waif.name: howling waif
mon_zombie_waif.description: Undeath has not been kind to the children of the apocalypse.  This one is little more than a reanimated membrane of skin stretched across tiny brittle bones.

mon_zombie_master.name: zombie master
mon_zombie_master.description: Once human, its features have tightened, its lips pulled back into an unnatural grin, revealing rows of blackened teeth beneath its large, piercing eyes.  It stands tall and its movements are fluid and tightly controlled.  A feeling of danger permeates the air around it, and the light that falls on it seems somehow harsher and more glaring.

mon_zombie_necro.name: zombie necromancer
mon_zombie_necro.description: A twisted mockery of the human form, emaciated, with jet black skin and glowing red eyes.  It is somehow painful to look at, awakening fears deep within your psyche, and even the air around it seems more sinister, somehow darker and more dangerous.

mon_skeleton_master.name: skeletal master
mon_skeleton_master.description: A strange zombie covered in bone plates from face to toe.  Despite the added weight on its body its movements are coordinated, almost as if capable of analyzing your movements.

mon_skeleton_necro.name: skeletal lich
mon_skeleton_necro.description: A twisted visage of the human body decked in bone from head to toe.  Its vague shape reminiscent of some tabletop monster, it walks and watches your actions with a cold and calculating demeanor.

mon_zombie_brute_shocker.name: shocker brute
mon_zombie_brute_shocker.description: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from what you can only guess was 'research'.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.

mon_zombie_electric.name: shocker zombie
mon_zombie_electric.description: A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

mon_zombie_nullfield.name: incandescent husk
mon_zombie_nullfield.description: This once-human is visible only as a glowing white silhouette that you have to squint to see, cloaked in a crackling field of lightning that pulses like a beating heart.  It walks slowly and deliberately, the thunderstorm surrounding it eagerly jumping to anything conductive within its grasp.

mon_zombie_static.name: zapper zombie
mon_zombie_static.description: A very pale dead body with the worst case of static hair you have ever seen.  Sometimes, you can see sparks of electricity around it.

mon_zombie_stormbringer.name: stormbringer
mon_zombie_stormbringer.description: Spewing blue lightning from its body, this bizarre zombie stares at its surroundings with a maniacal blue glow.  There is a murderous aura around it, and a cloud of condensed electrons hovers in the air.

special_attacks.monster_message: Stormbringer beckons, and the charged cloud condenses!

mon_stormbringer_electric_ball.name: shock vortex
mon_stormbringer_electric_ball.description: These swirls of electrified clouds are dangerous spheres made of condensed lightning that float slowly over the ground, seeking victims to engulf in their electrical storms.

mon_boomer.name: boomer
mon_boomer.description: A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief and layered in rolls of fat.  It emits a horrible odor, and a putrid pink sludge dribbles from its mouth.

mon_boomer_huge.name: huge boomer
mon_boomer_huge.description: This boomer, normally swollen and ready to burst, has strengthened and solidified.  The bile dribbling from its mouth also appears to have changed…

mon_gas_zombie.name: gasoline zombie
mon_gas_zombie.description: A huge bloated zombie that appears to have fed upon gasoline; fumes and flames escape from its mouth and fuel leaks from its waddling form.

mon_zombie_gasbag.name: bloated zombie
mon_zombie_gasbag.description: With its gray skin swollen to near rupture with putrid gas, this cyst covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.

mon_zombie_grenadier.name: zombie grenadier
mon_zombie_grenadier.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear.  Its hands constantly fumble at its many pouches.

bot_c4_hack.message: The zombie grenadier deploys a c4 hack

bot_flashbang_hack.message: The zombie grenadier deploys a flashbang hack

bot_gasbomb_hack.message: The zombie grenadier deploys a gasbomb hack

bot_grenade_hack.message: The zombie grenadier deploys a grenade hack

mon_zombie_grenadier_elite.name: zombie elite grenadier
mon_zombie_grenadier_elite.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and wearing a MOLLE pack.  Its hands quickly open and close its many pouches.

bot_c4_hack.message: The elite zombie grenadier deploys a c4 hack

bot_flashbang_hack.message: The elite zombie grenadier deploys a flashbang hack

bot_gasbomb_hack.message: The elite zombie grenadier deploys a gasbomb hack

bot_grenade_hack.message: The elite zombie grenadier deploys a grenade hack

bot_mininuke_hack.message: A klaxon blares from the elite zombie grenadier and you see a mininuke hack come out

mon_zomballoon.name: zomballoon
mon_zomballoon.description: An almost-spherical fetid human corpse that walks, or rather floats, again.  A good needle should be all you need to pop this problem.

mon_zomblimp.name: zomblimp
mon_zomblimp.description: The torso of this zombie is disgustingly egg-shaped, reminding one of the big balloons full of gas that used to fly over certain sports matches.  Something tells you that you'll need more than a sewing needle this time...

mon_crawler.name: crawler
mon_crawler.description: A conglomeration of human parts fused together in a horrible mishmash of function, slowly dragging its eldritch body across the ground.

mon_devourer.name: dissoluted devourer
mon_devourer.description: Human bodies fused together into a colossus with heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body.  You may have trouble estimating its healthiness and its capabilities might change.

mon_zombie_crushed_giant.name: trapped tendril
mon_zombie_crushed_giant.description: A great tendril of mutated flesh and sharpened bone.  Emergent from a crevice in the ruined floor, hundreds of human limbs seek freedom and writhe incessantly from underneath its grotesque carapace.  As enormous as it may already be, you feel certain that this is just part of a creature much bigger, for when it moves, you can feel this whole ruin tremble, as if an unseen giant struggled against the weight of its concrete tomb.

mon_zombie_gasbag_immobile.name: gangrenous flesh
mon_zombie_gasbag_immobile.description: Immobile from grievous wounds, its gray skin has bloated to near rupture with putrid gas.  Between lumps of unrecognizable gore, a human head lamely follows your walking with empty, black eyes.

mon_zombie_gasbag_crawler.name: gangrenous crawler
mon_zombie_gasbag_crawler.description: A nightmarish spidery abomination, born from human gore.  It deftly crawls between walls and ceiling with limbs grown from its own disjointed ribs.

mon_zombie_gasbag_impaler.name: gangrenous impaler
mon_zombie_gasbag_impaler.description: A corpse hideously twisted into an insect-like form.  A hollow tendril reaches out from its open thorax.

special_attacks.description: The impaler launches a barb!

mon_zombie_living_wall.name: flesh wall
mon_zombie_living_wall.description: A great lump of mutated flesh.  It resembles the innards of some gigantic creature and is covered in a grid of diminutive veins.

mon_zombie_scientist.name: zombie scientist
mon_zombie_scientist.description: Apart from the jet-black eyes, this zombie looks less decomposed and inhuman than most.  Clad in a tattered lab coat, it seems to have a glimmer of awareness - not a human awareness, but something more sinister.  As you watch it, its movements look almost marionette-like.

mon_zombie_scientist_evolved_igor.name: elite zombie scientist
mon_zombie_scientist_evolved_igor.description: What used to be the shambling corpse of some former scientist now glowers with an eerie intelligence in its eyes.  Though more steady on its feet, its hands fumble awkwardly for hidden devices within various pockets, and the faint hum of manhack motors follow in its wake.

mon_zombie_scientist_evolved_emp.name: zombie cybernetics researcher
mon_zombie_scientist_evolved_emp.description: Decaying flesh and torn laboratory safety gear reveal hints of embedded alloy plating and various bionics components.  Cutting-edge cybernetics seem to be the only thing keeping its rotting corpse intact, and one arm crackle with electromagnetic discharges as it reaches for its prey.

special_attacks.description: The cybernetic zombie discharges an integrated EMP projector!

mon_zombie_scientist_evolved_possessed.name: zombie xenotech
mon_zombie_scientist_evolved_possessed.description: Shadows envelop this creature, but you can faintly make out what used to be a lab coat.  Marked by whatever perversions of science it practiced in life, the movements of its silhouette seem more lively than expected, but far from human.

special_attacks.monster_message: Creeping darkness radiates from %s!

mon_zombie_scientist_admin.name: zombie lab administrator
mon_zombie_scientist_admin.description: Clad in a lab coat adorned prominently with an array of badges, this zombie was likely some sort of supervisor or administrator for the lab.  Though most of its IDs are useless now that the lab is on lockdown, it likely still carries a useful door override code.

mon_zombie_labsecurity.name: zombie security guard
mon_zombie_labsecurity.description: A shambling human corpse wearing a gray uniform and bulletproof vest with "SECURITY" emblazoned across the front.  It looks like the guard was quite physically fit before its death; it moves quickly and powerfully, albeit clumsily.

mon_zombie_nurse.name: nurse
mon_zombie_nurse.description: Instead of one of its forearms, this zombie has a muscular tube ending in a stinger that is moist with stringy slime.  It is single-mindedly focused on using just that one limb to fight.

mon_zombie_surgeon.name: surgeon
mon_zombie_surgeon.description: A dripping stinger where one hand would be, a set of razor-like claws in place of the other one.  This zombie's cold, focused eyes look down at you from above a "mask" of melded flesh.

mon_zombie_vivisector.name: vivisector
mon_zombie_vivisector.description: This humanoid has a long bone "syringe" in place of one forearm, a large saw as the opposing hand, and a pair of digitigrade legs ending in raptor-like feet.  Its head is featureless, except for its "human" eyes, which smile with inhuman malice and scorn.

mon_zombie_conjoiner.name: cadaver assembler
mon_zombie_conjoiner.description: With a grotesquely twisted body and four arms fused with surgical tools, this zombie obsessively regenerates nearby undead at an abnormal speed.  A dark aura flows over its pale skin, eerily healing damaged allies and spreading a distorted will to live.

special_attacks.monster_message: <color_yellow>Nearby zombies regenerate abnormally quickly.</color>

mon_zombie_biter.name: slavering biter
mon_zombie_biter.description: A distorted and swollen human body.  Its jaws have elongated into a crocodile like snout, dripping with foul smelling saliva.

mon_zombie_brainless.name: brainless zombie
mon_zombie_brainless.description: A zombie like any other, except that its features and skull have been devastated.  It's unclear what caused the damage, but between the scraps of flesh you can see that its face and brain are gone, though its ears are intact.

mon_zombie_brute.name: zombie brute
mon_zombie_brute.description: Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.

mon_zombie_brute_grappler.name: zombie wrestler
mon_zombie_brute_grappler.description: A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  Seems eager to strangle the life from you.

mon_zombie_brute_ninja.name: zombie nightstalker
mon_zombie_brute_ninja.description: Somehow this brute hides in the dark like some kind of boogeyman.  Very agile for such a large zombie.

mon_zombie_ears.name: listener zombie
mon_zombie_ears.description: The head of this zombie was once obviously destroyed, the gaps in its scraps of face now filling with a peculiar gray goo.  Human ears hang from the sides, enormous and unsettling.  Thin slits at the front suggest it may be able to see.

mon_zombie_grabber.name: grabber zombie
mon_zombie_grabber.description: A deformed human body, once living.  Its arms dangle from its sides like the limbs of some skinless ape, mindlessly groping at their surroundings.

mon_zombie_grappler.name: grappler zombie
mon_zombie_grappler.description: An undead humanoid, its elongated arms drag along the ground as it moves.  It looks to almost have a hunch from the swollen back and shoulder muscles tearing though its skin.

mon_zombie_hollow.name: zombie hollow
mon_zombie_hollow.description: Black hollow eyes survey the surroundings as the zombie stretches and bends in ways that whoever the original body belonged to never could.  The only thing that seems solid, on this flexible black-veined body, is the rows of sharp black teeth.  You get the feeling that the only human thing remaining is the skin, worn as one would wear clothes.

mon_zombie_hulk.name: zombie hulk
mon_zombie_hulk.description: A human body now swollen to the size of six men, with arms as wide as a trash can.

mon_zombie_nemesis.name: relentless hulk
mon_zombie_nemesis.description: A hulking zombie swollen to the size of six men.  Its inky black eyes are locked on you.  No matter how far you run, it always seems to find you.

mon_zombie_hunter.name: zombie hunter
mon_zombie_hunter.description: This once-human body is barely recognizable, scrambling about on all fours, its nails and teeth both sharpened into dangerous looking spikes.

mon_zombie_jackson.name: Thriller
mon_zombie_jackson.description:
And though you fight to stay alive,
Your body starts to shiver.
For no mere mortal can resist,
The evil of the thriller.

mon_zombie_mancroc.name: zombie snapper
mon_zombie_mancroc.description: With a crocodile-like snout and rows of protruding teeth, this swimwear-clad zombie lurks in the water.

mon_zombie_runner.name: zombie runner
mon_zombie_runner.description: This recently-risen body moves quickly, darting its head back and forth and gnawing at its hands.

mon_zombie_predator.name: zombie predator
mon_zombie_predator.description: With its joints in odd places and angles, this humanoid creature prowls across the landscape with surprising speed.  Its teeth and arms are sharpened into fine points, and black ooze seeps out from cuts between its muscles.

mon_zombie_screecher.name: screecher zombie
mon_zombie_screecher.description: A thin corpse, its chest is swollen in what appears to be preparation.  A thick black ooze drips from its open mouth.

mon_zombie_shady.name: shady zombie
mon_zombie_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human shaped outline.

mon_shia.name: Shia LaBeouf
mon_shia.description:
Living in the woods,
killing for sport,
eating all the bodies,
actual cannibal Shia LaBeouf.

mon_zombie_shrieker.name: shrieker zombie
mon_zombie_shrieker.description: An elongated human body with a swollen chest and a gaping hole where its jaw used to be.

mon_zombie_skull.name: skull zombie
mon_zombie_skull.description: This creature's head is a hideous gray skull, formed of human bone fragments and some sort of goo.  Jagged teeth are visible as the thing works its jaw and disturbingly human, lidless eyes stare at you from their sockets.  The thing's fleshy ears are four sizes too large and droop under their own weight.

mon_zombie_smoker.name: smoker zombie
mon_zombie_smoker.description: A blackened and twisted naked human body, strips of flesh hang from its body, and it emits a constant haze of thick black smoke.

mon_zombie_smoker_evolved_grappler.name: grappling smoker zombie
mon_zombie_smoker_evolved_grappler.description: A pale, gaunt corpse with smoke billowing from its torn flesh.  Its skin hangs in dry, tatter strips, but the exposed muscle underneath seems raw and pulsing with unlife, forming a nest of writhing worm-life tendrils.

mon_zombie_smoker_evolved_toxic.name: fuming husk
mon_zombie_smoker_evolved_toxic.description: A rotting, near-skeletal corpse with a putrid smell to it.  Its torn flesh weeps clouds of acrid, toxic gas.

mon_zombie_swimmer.name: swimmer zombie
mon_zombie_swimmer.description: A slick and glistening human body.  Its hands and feet are webbed, and it is clad in swimwear.

mon_zombie_squidman.name: zombie squidman
mon_zombie_squidman.description: This rotting, squid-faced thing somehow used to be human, judging by its tattered swimwear.  Its limbs have split apart and mutated into a mess of slimy tendrils, vomiting up bile when threatened in a twisted imitation of cephalopod ink.

mon_zombie_seaweed.name: zombie swamp-thing
mon_zombie_seaweed.description: A vaguely human-shaped mound of decaying plant matter and other detritus, this zombie has been dragged through the muck and then some.  Sharp, venomous thorns can be seen under all the debris clinging to it.

mon_zombie_seaweed_brute.name: swamp husk
mon_zombie_seaweed_brute.description: This bulky tangle of dead plants and other trash obscures the form of a now heavily-mutated zombie.  It reeks of dead plant, wisps of noixous fumes drifting from it as it shambles after its prey.

mon_zombie_technician.name: zombie technician
mon_zombie_technician.description: Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.

mon_zombie_technician_evolved_electric.name: electromagnetic zombie
mon_zombie_technician_evolved_electric.description: Looking like a walking power line accident, charred work clothes and safety gear are melted to this thing's body, which crackles with lightning.

mon_zombie_technician_evolved_iron.name: scrapyard zombie
mon_zombie_technician_evolved_iron.description: At first glance, you could almost mistake this for a pile of prime scrap metal.  The hum of bionics and scraping of its movements confirms it to actually be a zombie entirely covered in magnetically-attracted debris.

mon_zombie_technician_evolved_iron2.name: ironclad brute
mon_zombie_technician_evolved_iron2.description: This walking junkyard is either heavily mutated or just absolutely buried in debris stuck to it, its large form bristling with sharp scrap metal it can launch in magnetic pulses as it lumbers along.

special_attacks.description: The ironclad zombie discharges a hail of scraps from its body!

mon_zombie_foreman.name: zombie foreman
mon_zombie_foreman.description: Still wearing its hardhat and holding its clipboard, this zombie was likely the foreman of a construction crew, and if its access badge is anything to go by, a highly specialized one.  It still seems to grumble incoherent directions to its crew of zombie workers.

special_attacks.monster_message: The zombie foreman shouts and points, and spectral workers begin to gather around!

mon_zombie_foreman_minion.name: zombie worker
mon_zombie_foreman_minion.description: Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie shambles toward you at the orders of its foreman.  It wields a menacing sledgehammer, which it seems to have no trouble swinging despite its state.

mon_zombie_miner.name: zombie miner
mon_zombie_miner.description: This zombie's face, hands, work clothes, and miner's helmet are fully covered with stains of coal dust.

mon_zombie_miner_evolved_moleman.name: zombie tunneler
mon_zombie_miner_evolved_moleman.description: Long claws extend from the club-like hands of a pale zombie, its figure hunched over and pallid.  Horrid noises emit from it as it tunnels through obstacles and gnashes its deformed jaws.

mon_zombie_miner_evolved_shady.name: subterranean haunt
mon_zombie_miner_evolved_shady.description: Red eyes glower out from a shroud of living shadow, the dust-covered form of some abandoned workman seemingly carries the darkness of its underground resting place with it.

mon_zombie_thorny.name: thorny shambler
mon_zombie_thorny.description: A shambling undead humanoid, body overgrown with a tangled mass of otherworldly vegetation.  Hunched over and dragging its feet as it moves, the bramble utterly enveloping its upper half twitches and moves with a life of its own, tendrils tipped with a paralytic sting.

mon_zombie_darkfield.name: shroud weaver
mon_zombie_darkfield.description: Once human, this corpse has assimilated with the darkness of the netherworld.  A faint black fog rises from the corpse, and the closer you get to the horrific being, the more the light around you seems to be sucked away.

mon_banshee.name: banshee
mon_banshee.description: From its gaunt, twisted form, the banshee unleashes a piercing scream that tears through the air and disorients all who hear it.  This sonic assault is a crippling wave of pure fear that causes extreme mental and physical anguish.

special_attacks.monster_message: You heard a soul-chilling shriek!

mon_zombie_prisoner.name: prisoner zombie
mon_zombie_prisoner.description: Apparently this zombie was doing time when the Cataclysm struck.  It wears black and white striped prisoner clothes, and tattoos can be seen on his decaying skin.

mon_charred_nightmare.name: charred nightmare
mon_charred_nightmare.description: Intense radiation has spurred a unique form of necrosis and regeneration, it is impossible to tell if this creature was ever human.

mon_irradiated_wanderer_1.name: irradiated wanderer
mon_irradiated_wanderer_1.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

mon_irradiated_wanderer_2.name: irradiated wanderer
mon_irradiated_wanderer_2.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

mon_irradiated_wanderer_3.name: irradiated wanderer
mon_irradiated_wanderer_3.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

mon_irradiated_wanderer_4.name: irradiated wanderer
mon_irradiated_wanderer_4.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

mon_skeleton.name: skeleton
mon_skeleton.description: A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombie's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Large clumps of black goo seep from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the air around it.

mon_skeleton_brute.name: skeletal brute
mon_skeleton_brute.description: Distorted outgrowths of calcified bone plates cover this zombie's rotten skin.  Joints and cracks around its body ooze with black goo.

mon_skeleton_electric.name: skeletal shocker
mon_skeleton_electric.description: Heavy, jagged bone plates have grown out of the surface of this zombie.  Underneath, its flesh glows and crackles with the occasional jolt of electricity.

mon_skeleton_hulk.name: skeletal juggernaut
mon_skeleton_hulk.description: This hideous golem of plated bones and misshapen flesh drags its heavy, pointed limbs behind it like an unwanted burden.  Formerly soft and vulnerable, bones grew around its form to protect it - only, they kept growing.  And growing.  And growing.

mon_zombie_soldier.name: zombie soldier
mon_zombie_soldier.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.

mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_1.name: black-ops zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_1.description: This soldier zombie's skin radiates a sort of shadowy smoke that obscures its outline, making its camouflage even harder to see against the background.  In the darkness it would be nigh invisible.

mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_2.name: hunter-killer zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_2.description: Fragments of visible uniform hint that this monstrosity was once a soldier.  Anything human is invisible, hidden inside a sheath of living shadow.  It moves with preternatural fluidity and grace.

mon_zombie_soldier_acid_1.name: acid-sniper zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_acid_1.description: This staggering soldier wears a burnt gasmask, now fused to its face.  Through the melted, bile-encrusted ruination of the mask comes some sort of hardened fleshy proboscis, with steaming corrosive fluid leaking from the end.

special_attacks.description: The acid-sniper zombie launches a corrosive dart!

mon_zombie_soldier_acid_2.name: acid-support zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_acid_2.description: This zombie wears what appears to have once been a soldier's uniform and armor, now a series of cracked and melted plates that have fused to its skin and thickened hide.  Its face and arms blister with strange mutated tubes that pulse and drip with acid.

special_attacks.description: The acid-support zombie launches a hail of corrosive darts!

mon_zombie_soldier_acid_3.name: acid-juggernaut zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_acid_3.description: Destroyed hazard gear covers this zombie's grotesquely bloated body, which has been mutated by acidic compounds.  Its arms bear massive acid cannons that unleash a furious barrage of corrosive fluid, instantly melting anything that approaches.  Wherever this hulking monster treads, it leaves behind a trail of decayed, reeking residue, a testament to its overwhelming power.

special_attacks.description: The acid-juggernaut zombie launches a hail of corrosive darts!

mon_zombie_kevlar_0.name: Kevlar zombie
mon_zombie_kevlar_0.description: This zombie is wearing some kind of uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  However, the monster's skin has begun to grown over the fabric, splitting and tearing it to shreds, seemingly integrating the mess of Kevlar and ceramic into part of its hide.

mon_zombie_kevlar_1.name: Kevlar brute
mon_zombie_kevlar_1.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  At this point it's impossible to tell what kind of uniform it was: the monster's skin has grown over the fabric, splitting and tearing it to shreds, turning the remaining mess of Kevlar and ceramic into part of its hide.  Its hands, similarly, have fused into large leathery cudgels.

mon_zombie_kevlar_2.name: Kevlar hulk
mon_zombie_kevlar_2.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of now long-shredded uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  It has grown into a hulking, leatherbacked beast, its mutated skin taking on a strange texture similar to the Kevlar and ceramic bits embedded in it.  Its arms have twisted into enormous clubs of misshapen bone that it drags on the ground behind it.

mon_zombie_military_pilot.name: zombie military pilot
mon_zombie_military_pilot.description: Once a pilot, it is dressed in basic military fatigues, aviator sunglasses, and a sturdy looking helmet.

mon_zombie_flamer.name: zombie burner
mon_zombie_flamer.description: When bullets weren't enough to stop the end of the world, the military tried fire instead.  Their failure is made manifest in this gas-masked husk, its black suit torn and ripped.  Its flamethrower, dangling limply at its side, is attached to a tank of napalm strapped onto its back, which trickles its contents onto the ground.

mon_zombie_armored.name: armored zombie
mon_zombie_armored.description: Despite being encased in a what was once a nigh-impenetrable suit of power armor, something still managed to kill this soldier.

mon_zombie_bio_op.name: zombie bio-operator
mon_zombie_bio_op.description: This armored and augmented soldier's bionics crackle with energy.  Worse, it appears to remember its training.

mon_zombie_bio_op2.name: elite zombie bio-operator
mon_zombie_bio_op2.description: Once a highly trained soldier, various bionics cover this zombie's broken body.  Strangely, it maintains a vague martial arts stance.

mon_zombie_supply_sergeant.name: zombie sergeant
mon_zombie_supply_sergeant.description: This zombie's tattered uniform indicates it might have once been an NCO.  A bizarre entity still clinging to past obsessions and a sense of authority, as if it was still leading the charge against the enemy it fell against.  It summons echos of fallen soldiers, with a hoarse voice that perpetually sounds like grumbling.

special_attacks.monster_message: The zombie sergeant gargles with rage, and spectral troops begin to gather around!

mon_zombie_soldier_minion.name: zombie soldier
mon_zombie_soldier_minion.description: These are the pathetic beings reluctantly dragged into action under the coercive command of their commanding officer.  They still wear expressions of profound displeasure and exhibit a visibly annoyed demeanor, moving listlessly to commands that are a confused echo of their past lives.  Forcibly deployed, they shamble towards you, but their every movement clearly conveys, "Why do I have to do this?"

mon_zombie_soldier_shieldman.name: zombie shieldbearer
mon_zombie_soldier_shieldman.description: Wearing a military uniform, this zombie walks slowly as it hides its body behind a hefty shield. Appearing no different from any other fallen soldier aside from its defenses, a good solid hit should either wreck its precious shield or knock it out of its grasp.

mon_zombie_soldier_camo_1.name: camouflage zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_camo_1.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in a bulky camouflage suit, making it extremely hard to spot at long distance.

mon_zombie_soldier_camo_2.name: camouflaged hunter zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_camo_2.description: This agile zombie was once a soldier, being covered in tangles of camouflage material that have grown into its skin and change color to match it's background, making it nearly impossible to spot at long distances.

mon_zombie_survivor.name: survivor zombie
mon_zombie_survivor.description: Still wearing the tattered remnants of improvised armor and weaponry, it is plain to see that this zombie was once a survivor like you.

mon_zombie_survivor_elite.name: veteran survivor zombie
mon_zombie_survivor_elite.description: This zombie once was a survivor like you, and a pretty good one at that.  Unfortunately they didn't make it, despite the custom-made, heavy armor pieces they wear and the gear that they are still lugging around.

mon_zhark.name: jawed terror
mon_zhark.description: A once aggressive and hungry bull shark, this jawed terror is now even more aggressive, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.

mon_zombie_dog.name: zombie dog
mon_zombie_dog.description: The deformed, animated corpse of a canine, a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.

mon_dog_skeleton.name: skeletal dog
mon_dog_skeleton.description: This once-canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  Devoid entirely of flesh, this walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.

mon_dog_zombie_cop.name: Z-9
mon_dog_zombie_cop.description: A zombified version of one of the German shepherd dogs used in law enforcement.  Its deformed body is encased in a protective Kevlar harness.

mon_dog_zombie_rot.name: rot-weiler
mon_dog_zombie_rot.description: Acrid smell accompanies this corpse of canine.  Its whole body is covered in chains of pulsing cysts and slime-dribbling ulcers.

mon_zolf.name: grim howler
mon_zolf.description: A zombified wolf.  Its mouth oozes with a black substance, coating the vicious-looking white fangs.

mon_zombear.name: zombear
mon_zombear.description: This black bear's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It shuffles as it walks.

mon_zombie_pig.name: festering boar
mon_zombie_pig.description: A zombified omnivore descended from the wild boar.  Now it's got black goo all over it, instead of mud.

mon_zombeaver.name: zombeaver
mon_zombeaver.description: This wall-eyed beast has a large wound on its side, and ribs with some flesh on them are seen through it.  The most prominent feature of this abomination is large incisors in its ominously open mouth, strange black goo is oozing out of it.  Seems like it isn't interested in trees anymore and is looking for some warm flesh to feed.

mon_zoose.name: antlered horror
mon_zoose.description: This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection which is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is black and matted with necrotic discharge.

mon_zougar.name: decayed pouncer
mon_zougar.description: An otherwise normal-looking cougar, except that its hind legs are swollen, and its eyes bulge with black goo.

mon_zow.name: zombie cow
mon_zow.description: Once a placid cow, this leathery horror stumbles and shudders, its pulsing black eyes scanning for prey beneath wicked horns.  It is big and heavy and murderous.

mon_zeer.name: woodland wight
mon_zeer.description: Pale, stumbling white-tailed deer with blackened eyes and drooling slime down its neck.  Its legs twist and bend in strange, haphazard directions, but with unnatural strength and speed.  Preys on coyotes, wolves, and giant spider mutants.

mon_beekeeper.name: scarred zombie
mon_beekeeper.description: A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.

mon_zombie.name: zombie
mon_zombie.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.

mon_zombie_cop.name: zombie cop
mon_zombie_cop.description: A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged police uniform. A similarly damaged kevlar vest can be seen through the holes of its uniform.

mon_zombie_swat.name: zombie riot cop
mon_zombie_swat.description: A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged police uniform.  It still holds a riot shield, which it hides behind as it slowly walks.

mon_zombie_swat_boss.name: SWAT zombie
mon_zombie_swat_boss.description: This zombie was part of a specialized unit of law enforcement.  It still wears a battered armor with the SWAT logo emblazoned on the front, and it holds a tear gas grenade in its hands.

special_attacks.description: The SWAT zombie throws a tear gas grenade!

mon_zombie_crawler.name: crawling zombie
mon_zombie_crawler.description: This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its legs are damaged beyond repair.

mon_zombie_dancer.name: zombie dancer
mon_zombie_dancer.description:
The foulest stench is in the air,
The funk of forty thousand years,
And grisly ghouls from every tomb,
Are closing in to seal your doom!

The dancer doesn't even notice you, it seems like something nearby is controlling it.

mon_zombie_fat.name: fat zombie
mon_zombie_fat.description: Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.

mon_zombie_fireman.name: firefighter zombie
mon_zombie_fireman.description: A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.

mon_zombie_hazmat.name: hazmat zombie
mon_zombie_hazmat.description: This zombie's face and body is completely covered by a protective suit.  It wanders around, unsteadily.

mon_zombie_rot.name: decayed zombie
mon_zombie_rot.description: A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.

mon_zombie_tough.name: tough zombie
mon_zombie_tough.description: Once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.

mon_zombie_resort_dancer.name: sleek zombie
mon_zombie_resort_dancer.description: This zombie is rather sleek and barely clothed.

mon_zombie_resort_bouncer.name: bouncer zombie
mon_zombie_resort_bouncer.description: This zombie looks beefed and is dressed in the tattered remnants of a security uniform.

mon_zombie_resort_staff.name: zombie
mon_zombie_resort_staff.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.

mon_zombie_crawler_pupa_decoy.name: pupating zombie crawler
mon_zombie_crawler_pupa_decoy.description: This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

mon_zombie_crawler_pupa.name: pupating zombie crawler
mon_zombie_crawler_pupa.description: This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

mon_zombie_pupa_decoy.name: pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa_decoy.description: This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

mon_zombie_pupa.name: pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa.description: This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is strange rhythmic movement grotesque to behold.

mon_zombie_pupa_decoy_shady.name: shady pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa_decoy_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

mon_zombie_pupa_shady.name: shady pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

mon_zombie_winged.name: batwing zombie
mon_zombie_winged.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome fleshy membrane.  The mutation does not suit it well: it moves clumsily, even compared to other zombies.

mon_zombie_brute_winged.name: garghoul
mon_zombie_brute_winged.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome fleshy membrane.  The rest has become emaciated, thin rope-like muscles ripping through taut flesh.  While it doesn't appear to be able to truly fly, it uses its mutated arms to make shockingly fast leaps through the air.

mon_spawn_raptor.name: flesh-raptor
mon_spawn_raptor.description: This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a sheer jagged spike.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it was made of human parts.

mon_spawn_raptor_shady.name: shadow raptor
mon_spawn_raptor_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged pointed object.

mon_spawn_raptor_unstable.name: unstable flesh-raptor
mon_spawn_raptor_unstable.description: This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a jagged spike and a bloated fleshy belly.

mon_spawn_raptor_electric.name: zaptor
mon_spawn_raptor_electric.description: This small winged predator darts through the air on three thinly haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  Where the wings meet juts a jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow.

mon_deer_mouse.name: deer mouse
mon_deer_mouse.description: The white-footed mouse, a prolific rodent with a white underbelly and a long fuzzy tail.  A common sight in fields, forests, and research centers.

mon_dragonfly.name: dragonfly
mon_dragonfly.description: A thin-bodied insectoid predator with a large wingspan and big compound eyes.

mon_frog.name: bull frog
mon_frog.description: The American bullfrog, in its natural habitat.  It feeds on insects, mice, lizards and any other living thing it can stuff down its gullet.

mon_mosquito.name: mosquito
mon_mosquito.description: A blood-sucking fly with a needle-like proboscis.  Its bite leaves behind itchy welts and can easily spread disease.

mon_shrew.name: shrew
mon_shrew.description: The masked shrew, a mouse-like creature with a pointed, whiskery snout.  It digs tunnels into the ground in search of bugs to eat.

mon_slug.name: slug
mon_slug.description: The leopard slug, an omnivorous gastropod.  It consumes decaying matter as well as planted crops, and will attack and eat other slugs that cross its path.

mon_spider_jumping.name: jumping spider
mon_spider_jumping.description: A little spider with elongated forelegs.  It does not build extensive webs, but leaps very quickly, appearing to move instantaneously from one spot to another.

mon_spider_trapdoor.name: trapdoor spider
mon_spider_trapdoor.description: A midsized spider with a bulbous thorax.  It creates a subterranean nest and lies in wait for prey to draw close enough for capture.

mon_spider_widow.name: black widow spider
mon_spider_widow.description: An infamous spider with a characteristic red hourglass marking on its black carapace, known for its highly toxic bite.

mon_spider_wolf.name: wolf spider
mon_spider_wolf.description: A fairly large spider which tracks and catches prey through agility and stealth.  Its bite can be irritating even to large animals.

mon_turret_rifle.name: M249 autonomous CROWS II
mon_turret_rifle.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  Thousands of these were deployed by the US military before the Cataclysm and they were valued for their use in engaging infantry without exposing the operator.  This one is fitted with a M249.

mon_crows_m240.name: M240 autonomous CROWS II
mon_crows_m240.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  Thousands of these were deployed by the US military before the Cataclysm and they were valued for their use in engaging infantry without exposing the operator.  This one is fitted with a M240.

mon_turret_bmg.name: M2HB autonomous CROWS II
mon_turret_bmg.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  Thousands of these were deployed by the US military before the Cataclysm and they were valued for their use in engaging anything up to light vehicles at long range without exposing the operator.  This one is fitted with a M2HB.

mon_turret.name: improvised MP5 turret
mon_turret.description: An MP5 attached to a motorized chassis with basic autonomous software control.  There is no mechanism to reload the weapon when its magazine is empty and the fire control system is only designed for semi automatic fire.

mon_fungaloid_dormant.name: fungaloid
mon_fungaloid_dormant.description: A pale white fungus, one meaty gray stalk supporting a bloom at the top.  Spores are periodically expelled from its gills, and a few tendrils extend from the base, allowing mobility and some basic means of defense.

mon_zombie_fast.name: zombie dog
mon_zombie_fast.description: The deformed, animated corpse of a canine, a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.
